Secondly, based on the structural characteristics of VSPSU, the operational constraint equations are confirmed. Then, considering the operational cost, its impact on system flexibility and the operation constraints, a day-ahead dispatching operation strategy of VSPSU is proposed using the bacterial colony chemotaxis algorithm under the scenario of a high proportion of new energy units. By adjusting the operation conditions and output power of VSPSU, the effect of suppressing system power fluctuations can be achieved.

articleTitle: Robustly optimal operation in inverter-dominant microgrids facilitating small-signal stability
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Towards the carbon neutrality, more renewable energy sources (RESs) are integrated to the power system whose inevitably intermittent nature and sudden fluctuations may jeopardize the system stability. Therefore, the conventional robustly optimal energy management alone is not sufficient because the negative impact on the small-signal should be mitigated. This paper proposes a robust optimization model which aims to minimize the total cost without violating the stability constraint with incorporating adjustable droop gains in distributed energy resources (DERs) interfaced droop controlled inverters. An hourly optimal power flow problem with the RESs interval predictions is designed to guarantee the robustness against the uncertainties of RESs. With a polyhedral uncertain set, the proposed model can be solved by the Benders decomposition based approach with a series of analytical stability sensitivity cuts. These cuts are applied to enforce the stability to satisfy the corresponding constraints. Simulation results on the 33-bus microgrid reveal that compared to benchmarking approaches, the proposed model facilitates the small-signal stability with relatively low cost against RESs uncertainties.

articleTitle: Hybrid energy storage power allocation strategy to smooth out wind power fluctuations
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: For the hybrid energy storage system (HESS) power allocation problem used in smoothing wind power fluctuations, a hybrid energy storage power allocation strategy based on the sparrow search algorithm (SSA) to optimize the variational modal decomposition (VMD) parameters is proposed. First, the wind power is smoothed by exponential smoothing method based on wind power grid-connected criteria, and the accurate reference power of hybrid energy storage is obtained. Secondly, the modal number K and the quadratic penalty term α are substituted into VMD after SSA optimization to decompose the hybrid energy storage target power, and obtain multiple frequency band components, which are divided into high frequency components and low frequency components and assigned to hybrid energy storage. Finally, a fuzzy controller is designed to optimize the SOC of the energy storage device and adjust its SOC in real time to keep it in a suitable range.

articleTitle: Flexibility assessment of distribution networks with high penetration of new energy sources
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: This paper incorporates nodal flexibility resources and network flexibility resources into the flexibility assessment of distribution networks. It establishes quantitative evaluation index for the flexibility of distribution networks from two perspectives: flexibility supply and demand balance and branch load margin. The improved TPC84 node is used for case verification, and typical daily scenarios of light and wind speed are obtained using scenario reduction and AP algorithm clustering. Three different optimization schemes for accessing flexibility resources are considered, and the flexibility evaluation indicators are used for analysis and comparison. It is found that nodal flexibility resources can reduce the insufficient upregulation and downregulation flexibility rates, while network flexibility resources can increase the branch load margin. This verifies the feasibility of the evaluation indexes and the effectiveness of different flexibility resources in improving the flexibility adjustment ability of the system.

articleTitle: An extensive differential protection strategy for the thyristor controlled phase shifting transformer based on current equal amplitude characteristic
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: This paper proposes an extensive differential protection strategy that can cover the full thyristor controlled phase shifting transformer (TCPST) based on the equivalent circuit model of the TCPST. The proposed strategy uses the characteristics of equal amplitude of incoming and outgoing line currents of the series transformers. Meanwhile, the strategy can significantly improve the coverage and reliability of the main protection of the TCPST. Finally, the effectiveness of its protection strategy is verified under various fault state

articleTitle: Peak energy consumption trading mechanisam study based on power system low carbon demand response
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: In China's current electricity market, time-of-use (ToU) pricing system could preliminarily achieve the optimal allocation of energy resources. However, the high energy consumption and low energy efficiency issue has not neither been included in energy costs nor reflected through energy prices. Most provinces face pressure on electricity supply, especially during peak periods of commercial and residential electricity consumption. When the power generation capacity of hydropower or renewables has sharply decreased and only thermal power units play a peak period generation role, this situation leads to high carbon emissions in power system. Therefore, this paper proposes a peak energy consumption trading mechanism based on low carbon demand response. The paper first analyses the background and necessity of peak energy consumption trading mechanism study. Then puts forward the specific mechanism design of peak energy consumption trading system including the overall mechanism concept, allocation rules, transaction rules and price mechanism etc., based on power system low carbon demand response theory and practice. Further, this paper provides new ideas and insights for the coupling of electricity and carbon market constructions, giving mechanism innovations for the subsequent study of electricity-carbon coupling and power system carbon emission optimization.

articleTitle: Influence of new energy at the sending end on the calculation of single-end equivalent model of LCC-HVDC sending system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The short circuit current characteristics of LCC-HVDC transmission system are directly related to the action characteristics of AC protection at the inverter side. However, the single-end equivalent model of the existing LCC-HVDC transmission system regards the sending end as a pure traditional AC power supply, and the equivalent error is large when the sending end contains a high proportion of new energy. Based on the dynamic phasor equivalent calculation framework, this paper establishes a single-end equivalent model of the LCC-HVDC transmission system based on the AC information of the inverter side only, and analyzes the impact of different new energy proportion scenarios on the single-end equivalent error and the causes of the error. In this paper, simulation verification is carried out under the scenario of multiple new energy ratios at the sending end. The results show that the simulation error of the single-end equivalent model increases with the increase of the proportion of new energy, which reduces the credibility of the single-end equivalent calculation.

articleTitle: Cost causation based allocations of power regulation costs
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The proliferation of renewable energy (RE) and various inflexible loads (IL) exacerbate power variability, which poses great challenges to the system power regulation. Quantifying the regulation cost attributable to different types of genera-tion and load is conducive to facilitating the permanent power regulation services. This paper proposes a cost allocation method of power regulation based on cost causation to quantify the regulation cost caused by system participants that may exacerbate power variability. First, the ideal scenario of RE and IL without power variations is constructed to serve as the baseline for calculating regulation cost. Subsequently, a comprehensive dispatch model considering deep peak regulation and demand-side dispatch is established to calculate the total operation cost of the system. The total regulation cost attributable to variability is obtained via calculating the cost difference between the actual dispatch and the ideal scenario. Finally, the Shapley value is leveraged to quantify the power regulation cost caused by each RE and IL partici-pant. Simulation tests verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimization model of distributed energy supply system based on multi-energy complementarity
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The distributed energy supply system based on multi-energy complementarity is currently a research hotspot in the field of energy engineering, and the key issue faced by this system is operation optimization. The reasonable configuration or not directly affects the economic benefits and operational efficiency of the system. This article focuses on this key issue faced by distributed energy supply systems with multiple complementary energy sources. Taking a cultural tourism park as the research object, considering factors such as economic indicators, energy consumption, and carbon emissions, a multi-objective optimization model for distributed energy supply systems with multiple complementary energy sources is established by gradually decomposing and introducing hourly energy constraints. Experiments have shown that compared to traditional systems, this model can achieve hourly operation optimization and has good economic efficiency and energy-saving and emission-reduction benefits. Therefore, it provides a good reference and reference for the energy supply and comprehensive energy planning of multi-energy complementary distributed energy supply systems.

articleTitle: Lyapunov stability-based model predictive control of modular multilevel converters
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: In recent years, model predictive control has been widely used in modular multilevel converters (MMC) because of its simple principle, fast dynamic response, and multi-objective cooperative control. The advantage of model predictive control is that the objective function increases the flexibility of constraints, but the design of weight coefficients and the coupling effect between multiple constraints easily lead to instability, which limits its application. To address this problem, a Lyapunov stability-based model predictive control strategy is proposed. The proposed method doesn't require the design of weight coefficients for the objective function, and the number of onsets of the upper and lower bridge arm sub-modules is obtained by inverse prediction of the AC side voltage, and the control of the AC side output current and loop current suppression are achieved by Lyapunov stability criterion analysis. Finally, the MMC simulation test is built on MATLAB/Simulink, and the proposed method is verified to have the characteristics of fast dynamic response and high stability through simulation comparison analysis.

articleTitle: Policy and business model suggestions based on global and China distributed renewable energy development
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Renewable energy has experienced a rapid development and fast growth during the past years. For example, only in 2022, newly installed solar power generation capacity reached 86 GW, among which distributed solar power generation contributed to roughly one third. Many countries have worked out different policies to encourage distributed renewable development, and varies business models were formed. But business models of distributed renewable energy in China are currently simple without many choices. Due to the outdated definition and the unclear grid connection requirements, the potential for renewable energy development is limited. This paper summarized policies and business models in different countries, concluded the grid connection design standards and requirements, presented the challenges in different development stage and the requirements of modern power system. Then, the most advanced technologies those assisted to solve the problems were introduced. Finally, there were policy suggestions put forward based on global renewable energy development revelation. The suggestions contained project management, business and investment model, grid connection rules, policy incentives, and social consciousness.

articleTitle: Electric power inspection equipment: overview, challenges, and applications
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: In this paper, we provide a comprehensive review of electric power inspection equipment to promote technological innovation in electrical inspection equipment. We review the research status of electrical inspection equipment from three aspects: inspection equipment types and their pros and cons. Specifically, we describe the characteristics of inspection equipment from the perspective of specific working conditions and elaborate on scene requirements. We emphasize the technical status of electrical detection equipment and conduct a rational analysis of technical issues such as accuracy and efficiency. We also identify some key challenges and predict future development trends. Finally, we discuss the mechanical structure, control technology, and image processing of inspection equipment.

articleTitle: A two-dimensional asymmetric double-Gaussian model to simulate evolution of wind turbine wakes
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: A proper wake analytical model is not only important for power prediction of wind turbines under wake effects but also the key for coordinated control of a wind farm. A new two-dimensional wake analytical model named that is able to simulate downstream wake spatial evolution along horizontal is proposed in this paper. This model is derived according to the law of momentum conservation as well as the mass conservation. It is verified through a comparison with the results of CFD simulations under different turbulence conditions. Wind speed measurement results obtained from sixteen-beam LiDARs mounted on the hubs of eleven wind turbines at a wind farm are further used to validate the accuracy of this model. This study provides important insights into the development of the analytical wake model of wind turbines.

articleTitle: Physics-based and private-data-driven secure state estimation of three-phase unbalanced distribution networks
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The traditional state perception technology of distribution networks based on a single physics-based model or data-driven model cannot meet the requirements of new-type power systems for real-time perception and privacy-preserving security. In this paper, a security state perception model considering physical knowledge and private data is proposed for three-phase unbalanced distribution networks. Aiming at a new invisible False Data Injection Attack (FDIA) which considers both attackers' preference and attack library matrix, the principle and stealthiness of FDIA attack are analysed and demonstrated from the perspective of physics-based model. A distributed data-driven security detection algorithm is proposed by using the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) method. Different attack intensifies are set in the IEEE 123 distribution system by comparing the proposed distributed algorithm with the centralized algorithm and the largest normalized residual (LNR), respectively. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified via the detection accuracy and convergence speed. The privacy-preserving security of the state perception algorithm is improved by merely analysing and calculating the private data at the local node.

articleTitle: Study on calculation method of main circuit parameters in UHV cascade project
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The UHV DC project plays an important role in the optimal allocation of energy resources in China. With the proposal of the dual-carbon goal, UHV will also become one of the important ways to absorb new energy. The construction of UHV in the future may be multi-point transmission and multi-point absorption. The calculation of main circuit for different forms of connection will also be different. The calculation of main circuit parameters is the basis for the calculation of other main equipment parameters. This paper first analyzes the possible operation modes of the multi-terminal DC project, and then analyzes the possible operation modes for the connection topology of the sender-end sub-address cascade. At the same time, it proposes the main circuit calculation method suitable for the sender-end sub-address cascade, and proposes the main circuit operation characteristics under different connection modes under different operation modes, providing a feasible scheme for the subsequent calculation of the main circuit parameters under the multi-terminal cascade main connection topology.

articleTitle: Fault ride-through performance evaluation method of photovoltaic power station based on accurate model
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Fault ride-through capability is an important indicator of grid-connected performance of photovoltaic power stations, and a fault ride-through performance evaluation method based on accurate model is proposed to view the difficulties brought by the detection of fault ride-through capacity caused by the large scale of the whole station and many power generation units. Firstly, the fault ride-through performance test of the PV inverter is carried out, detailed response performance data is obtained, and the PV inverter model is established based on the test data. Then the inverter is extracted on site at the photovoltaic power station to check its fault ride-through performance consistently; On this basis, combined with the electrical structure of the power station, the photovoltaic power station model is established, and the fault ride-through performance of the power station is evaluated by modeling various fault conditions. Finally, this method is used to evaluate the fault ride-through performance of typical photovoltaic power stations, and the results show the effectiveness and availability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Isolated microgrid energy storage capacity planning considering the fluctuation of distributed renewable uncontrollable power output
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: In view of the high proportion of fluctuation distributed renewable uncontrollable energy in isolated microgrid, there may be issues of low utilization of renewable energy power and insufficient output in some periods. Installing of energy storage capacity in isolated microgrids can improve energy utilization, achieve the reliable operation of isolated microgrids and improve the economy of microgrid operation. This paper firstly establishes an energy storage capacity planning model with the goal of maximizing the operational efficiency of microgrids. The model considers the optimal economic operation of microgrid under the fluctuation of typical distributed uncontrollable power output. By utilizing Time of use price policy, the capacity of energy storage device is determined while ensuring load demand. Secondly, the paper adopts a dynamic inertia weights particle swarm optimization algorithm to solve the proposed model, effectively avoiding the problem of particle swarm optimization algorithm is prone to falling into local optimal. Finally, an example is given to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Application of non-contact acoustic monitoring in GIS breakdown locating
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: This paper proposes a non-contact acoustic visualization monitoring method for locating breakdown discharge position in gas insulated switchgear (GIS) during alternating current (AC) withstand voltage test in the ultra-high voltage (UHV) converter stations in order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of locating. While normal methods usually require a large number of sensors due to the numerous branch buses and interval equipment in GIS, this method in paper uses acoustic imaging and distributed acoustic location technology to detect the breakdown position in real time without contacting the equipment. Firstly, we researched the principle of acoustic locating and visualization, and proposed an acoustic visualization method based on the Generalized Inverse Beamforming (GIB) algorithm for locating breakdowns. Then we developed the monitoring system based on this theory. Finally, we applied the proposed method in a field test at one of the UHV converter stations and verified the breakdown position by dismantling the GIS equipment. The results show that this method can meet the actual needs, and it provides a new technical means for finding GIS insulation defects.

articleTitle: A novel distance protection for phase-to-phase short-circuit fault on AC collection line in VSC-HVDC system with offshore wind farm integration based on measured impedance correction
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Nonlinear fault response of power electronics poses challenges to the reliability of protection. As the power electronic converters being connected to both ends of the AC collection line in the VSC-HVDC system with offshore wind farm integration, the fault characteristics of the AC collection line has completely changed, and the adaptability of protection is seriously affected. Distance protection is not reliable enough to endure the fault resistance due to the fault current characteristics in amplitude and phase angle on AC collection line. When a phase-to-phase short-circuit occurs with fault resistance, the distance protection has the worst performance. To address this problem, the fault characteristics of AC collection line in VSC-HVDC system with offshore wind farm integration are analysed to establish the relationship between measured impedance and fault line impedance for phase-to-phase short-circuit fault. Based on measured impedance correction, a novel distance protection scheme for phase-to-phase short-circuit on the AC collection line in VSC-HVDC system with offshore wind farm integration is proposed. The correctness and effectiveness of the proposed protection scheme are verified through simulations based on PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: Real-time monitoring and short-term forecasting of regional carbon emissions based on coupled electric-carbon models
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Achieving accurate monitoring and forecasting of carbon emissions can provide timely and quantitative guidance to regions and enterprises in the process of low carbon development. Based on the carbon emission flow theory, a calculation method using regional dynamic emission factors is proposed to realize the accurate calculation of regional indirect carbon emissions; a quadratic optimization algorithm is used to transform low frequency (annual) data into high frequency (monthly) data, and an electric-carbon analysis model is constructed using an auto regressive distributed lag (ARDL) model based on time series to realize the accurate calculation of regional direct carbon emissions. The above model was applied to the real-time monitoring and short-term prediction of regional carbon emissions, and the effectiveness of the proposed method was verified through simulation calculations. The simulation results show that the proposed model can accurately monitor and predict regional carbon emissions and refine the resolution of carbon emission data.

articleTitle: Transformer-less integrated wind turbine-power transmission line systems
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The integrated wind turbine-power transmission line systems integrate wind turbines into high-voltage power transmission lines by directly interconnecting wind turbines to high-voltage power transmission lines without using high-voltage power transformers. In such systems, by considering double-circuit power transmission lines, creating a specific phase difference between two power transmission lines can lead to creating an appropriate voltage difference vector between them for injecting the power of wind turbines into power transmission lines without using high-ratio step-up power transformers. Then, a number of power transformers, which are termed receiving-end transformers, absorb the injected power of wind turbines. Such transformers increase the complexity and overall cost of the system. In this paper, an improved method for creating a voltage difference vector between two power transmission lines in an integrated wind turbine-power transmission line system is proposed. In addition, a new approach for injecting the power of wind turbines into power transmission lines and delivering to the load center without the need for receiving-end transformers is presented. The proposed method and its operation are analyzed in MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Research on generic electromechanical transient simulation model of distributed solar photovoltaic power generation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: China is currently pursuing the ambitious goals of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality, building a new power system with renewable energy as the main body. In the future, distributed solar photovoltaic (DPV) power generation will become a key component of renewable energy development. With the increasing scale of grid-connected DPV, its influence on power system stability will become more obvious and cannot be ignored. However, there is no suitable model for large power system time-domain electromechanical transient simulation. DPV is usually replaced by load or centralized PV power station model, which cannot reflect the real dynamic characteristics. This paper proposes a typical active and reactive power control strategy of DPV considering the simulation requirements of large-scale DPV in the future, such as frequency and voltage regulation, voltage ride through control. Then, this paper establishes a positive sequence phasor model of converter and control system, and combined with PV array model, proposes a generic electromechanical transient simulation model for DPV power generation. Finally, simulation experiments are made, results show that the proposed model can describe the transient characteristics of DPV, and suitable for simulation of DPV connected into large power system.

articleTitle: Wind-solar-electric vehicles coordinated optimization scheduling method based on weather classification and output-load matching
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Wind-solar-electric vehicles coordination optimization scheduling can effectively reduce the adverse effects of multiple uncertainties of wind/solar output and disorderly charging of electric vehicles on the power system. Most of the existing optimization scheduling models take the minimum variance of equivalent load as the optimization objective, which only considering the overall fluctuation of equivalent load, ignoring the ability of wind and solar power to track load changes and the difference under different weather types. To address the above problems, a coordination optimization scheduling method of wind-solar-electric vehicles based on output-load matching is proposed. Firstly, the disordered charging model of electric vehicles based on Monte Carlo simulation is constructed by analyzing the driving law of electric vehicles. Then, wind-solar output weather type classification model is constructed based on the forecasting data of wind and solar power. Finally, the optimization scheduling model is established with the minimum equivalent load variance and load tracking coefficient as the double optimization objectives. The results demonstrate that the proposed model can effectively reduce the fluctuation of equivalent load, so as to reduce the adverse effects of multiple uncertainties of wind/solar output and disorderly charging of electric vehicles on the power system.

articleTitle: Large-eddy simulation study of wind-turbine wakes in the coastal stable atmospheric boundary layer
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: There are many wind farms built in coastal areas. When the wind blows from land to sea, surface roughness and temperature change abruptly. However, the evolution of wind-turbine wakes in this condition is still not well understood to date. To this end, we use large-eddy simulation to study the wind turbine wake in the coastal stable atmospheric boundary layer characterized by an abrupt rough-to-smooth surface roughness and high-to-low surface temperature transition. Results show that the wind speed near the ground gradually increases at locations closer to the abrupt location dominated the abrupt roughness reduction. As the distance increases, the effect of surface temperature reduction gradually becomes apparent, suppressing the vertical momentum transport and leading to the velocity reduction. The farther away from the abrupt location, the greater the difference between the local shear stress and inflow shear stress, and a three-layer structure is formed. When the distance between the wind turbine and the abrupt location decreases, the wake recovery becomes faster. This is mainly because, with the decrease in the distance, the spanwise and vertical Reynolds shear stresses increase in the wake region and the corresponding spanwise and vertical turbulent transport increase.

articleTitle: Low carbon scheduling strategy of regional integrated energy system with concentrated solar power plant and carbon capture system based on IGDT
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: For a regional integrated energy system (RIES) containing concentrated solar power (CSP) plant and power-to-gas (P2G) operating in concert with carbon capture system (CCS), this paper proposes a multi-energy coupled RIES low carbon scheduling strategy based on information gap decision theory (IGDT), taking into account the uncertainty of system wind power output, light intensity, and load. Firstly, a RIES low-carbon scheduling model with CSP plants and P2G operating in collaboration with CCS is constructed. Secondly, based on the uncertainty characteristics of wind power output, light intensity, and load demand, a multi-energy coupled robust scheduling model and an opportunity scheduling model are established by introducing IGDT, and the overall scheduling strategy process is given. By adjusting the level factor values of the model, optimal scheduling decisions under different risks can be achieved. Finally, the strategy can fully quantify the impact of uncertainty factors on the scheduling operation, improve the economy of system operation and reduce carbon emissions, as obtained through the analysis of calculation cases.

articleTitle: An active inertia control strategy of motor load for islanded microgrid frequency regulation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Islanded microgrid has low inertia and weak frequency dynamic stability, while the cost of installing energy storage to participate in frequency regulation is relatively high. Therefore, it is necessary to fully consider the rotational inertia of the motor loads. In this paper, a model p redictive control strategy is proposed to adaptively adjust the motor speed, enabling the motor load to respond actively and minimize the frequency deviation. The state space equation of frequency speed and the frequency increment prediction model of islan ded microgrid are firstly developed. A cost function that incorporates both the frequency dynamic response and the optimal control performance of motor load is proposed. An islanded microgrid model is developed based on MATLAB Simulink and simulation resul ts confirm that the motor load can effectively contribute to frequency dynamic regulation with a controllable operation trajectory.

articleTitle: Transient high frequency voltage protection method for ring DC microgrid with current limiting reactor
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: DC line protection is the key to the development of DC microgrid technology. Current limiting reactor provides convenience for the design of DC fault protection algorithm. Aiming at the Ring DC microgrid with current-limiting reactor, this paper uses the fault transient high frequency voltage characteristics of current limiting reactor to propose a protection method based on the high frequency voltage to ground at both sides of current-limiting reactor, and uses the difference of high frequency voltage to ground at both sides of current-limiting reactor on both ends of the line after a fault to identify faults inside and outside the zone. If the impedance on the back of the line is capacitive, the protection cannot operate correctly. This problem can be solved by selecting the appropriate frequency. The simulation results show that the proposed protection method can identify the fault line and fault pole quickly and accurately, with high sensitivity and reliability, easy threshold setting and no protection cooperation between adjacent lines, and low requirements for data synchronization. The proposed method can reliably identify and select fault poles under different fault scenarios and operating modes, and has strong resistance to transition resistance.

articleTitle: Coordination and interaction of source grid load and storage considering flexibility and economy
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: In this paper, a multi-time scale optimal dispatching strategy considering the day-ahead, intra-day and real-time phases is proposed, which takes into account multiple cooperation and interaction of source, grid, load and storage. First, basic framework of coordination and interaction of source, grid, load and storage is introduced. Then, the market trading mechanism of flexible ramping product (FRP) and the multi-time scale dispatching model of coordination and interaction of source, grid, load and storage are established. Finally, an example analysis is carried out to verify the flexibility and economy of the proposed model. The result shows that FRP can effectively improve the ability of the system to deal with uncertainty in the real-time phase.

articleTitle: On the correlation and complementarity assessment of ocean wind, solar and wave energy resources
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Due to climate issues and energy crisis, the development and usage of marine renewable energies are on the rise. However, ocean wind, solar and wave energies are intermittent, and there are few studies investigated the correlation and complementarity of these ocean renewable energy resources. This study investigates the energy density, variability, correlation, and complementarity of these three marine renewable energy sources in the South China Sea and its surrounding areas, based on the ERA5 database in 2022. The study points out that wind and wave energies are enriched in the northern and central South China Sea, and solar energy is evenly distributed. Numerical results also reveal that the temporal distribution of solar energy in the South China Sea is most stable, followed by wind energy and wave energy. In this study, solar energy shows complementary feature with wind and wave energies, while wind and wave energies are correlated. The results are expected to provide a basic guideline for the design of hybrid ocean renewable energy platforms.

articleTitle: Emergency discharge price strategy of microgrid based on discharge response of electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: In the isolated microgrid with a high proportion of distributed wind power, the small probability of short-term shortage of wind resources will cause a power supply gap. In this context, as a "mobile" power response resource, electric vehicles can alleviate the shortage of power capacity and improve the power supply reliability of isolated microgrid under certain price incentive policies. Firstly, based on single EV discharge power-price curve and discharge response degree-price of EV group, the relationship between the emergency power supply cost of microgrid and the EV discharge responsiveness is analyzed. Secondly, by opportunity cost minimization, the conditions and specific price strategies of EV discharge guided through EV discharge price for isolated microgrid are analyzed. Thirdly, the price mechanism of emergency discharge for EV in isolated microgrid is proposed, and the influence of EV emergency discharge price to microgrid benefits and EV battery losses is considered. Fourthly, the variable-step search algorithm is used to solve the model, which effectively avoids the possibility of inaccurate optimal solution caused by step deviation. Finally, through the analysis of examples, the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm are verified.

articleTitle: Numerical investigation on the aerodynamic performances of a twin-rotor vertical-axis wind turbine in motions of a floating platform
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Compared with fixed bottom vertical axis wind turbines (VAWTs), floating VAWTs have greater development potential, but the movements of a floating platform can not only affect the aerodynamic loads, but also may alter the wake characteristics of the wind turbines. In this paper, a twin-rotor vertical axis wind turbine with a symmetrical NACA0021 airfoil profile, mounted on a semi-submersible platform is proposed. A counter-rotating configuration is adopted for the two rotors. A computational fluid dynamic (CFD) method is employed to solve Navies-Stokes equations, combined with a shear stress transport (SST) k-ω turbulence model. Considering surge and sway motions of the floating platform in extreme waves, a oneway coupling to the twin-rotor VAWT is implemented, in which the influence of the aerodynamic loads to that of the platform motion is ignored with the assumption that this effect is negligible, and the impacts of the coupling such as aerodynamic forces (torque, tangential force, normal forces) in various motion periods and amplitudes, are analysed in detail.

articleTitle: Trust region policy optimization-based secondary frequency regulation for isolated microgrid with voltage constraint
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: In order to overcome the frequency fluctuations caused by the uncertain random disturbances due to new energy sources, a data-driven automatic power generation control (DD-SFR) theory is proposed in this paper to achieve the optimal control performance and economic performance synthesis. In order to realize this theory, the paper adopts the trust region policy optimization (TRPO) algorithm, replaces the original SFR controller with an agent that can make independent decisions, and uses the strong robustness of the confidence domain strategy optimization algorithm to realize the adaptive control of microgrid frequency by reasonably setting the reward function of the agent. The simulation for microgrid of Southern Power Grid proves that the proposed algorithm can effectively reduce frequency deviation and generation cost.

articleTitle: A dynamic wake model for wind turbines based on hybrid physical process and data-driven method
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: In this work, a dynamic wind turbine wake model is proposed by using hybrid physical process and data-driven mothed, which can predict the instantaneous wake speed by using the inflow instantaneous wind speed only. The model decomposes the instantaneous inflow wind speed into the average and fluctuating components, and then predicts them using a steady-state wake model and a neural network model, respectively. And the total instantaneous wake wind speed is obtained by adding the two components. The model is trained using large eddy simulation data of wind turbines under different thrust coefficients, and the input features and output labels are determined by the correlation analysis of inflow and wake wind speeds. The results show that the proposed model has high accuracy and efficiency, the overall root mean square error of the second wind speed prediction is about 8.85%, and the calculation time is equivalent to that of the steady-state wake model. In addition, compared with the pure data-driven dynamic wake model, the proposed model can be applied to wind turbines with different thrust coefficients, and the prediction accuracy of the model will not increase with the increase of time span.

articleTitle: Transient voltage stability assessment incorporating uncertainties of wind-PV generation and load
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: As the penetration levels of wind and PV power generation increase dramatically, the voltage stability of modern power system has to face new problems and great challenges due to the inherent uncertainties of renewable energies. In this paper, a transient voltage stability assessment framework incorporating the wind-PV-load uncertainties is proposed, aiming to effectively identify the system weak points by analysing the influence of renewable energy penetration level and wind-PV-load uncertainties on the system transient voltage. Firstly, a data-driven method combined with the scenario analysis technology is utilized to model the uncertainties of wind-PV generation and load. Next, a cumulative low voltage index (CLVI) is proposed to assess the influence of cumulative effect of continuous low voltage on transient voltage stability from both time and voltage, which reflect the security level of the system voltage during transient process. In addition, the stochastic dominance theory is utilized to identify the system weak points, in which the order relationship between the CLVIs of different buses can be described in the stochastic order. Finally, the case studies are carried out on the modified IEEE 39-bus test system to demonstrate the validity of the proposed indices and the method applied.

articleTitle: A coordinated optimization strategy of blade pitch and yaw-based wake control for maximizing offshore wind farm output
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Studies have shown that wake disturbances in large wind farms especially offshore ones can lead to considerable productivity losses. Most of the existing studies use optimized layouts of wind farm to avoid the problem, or use simplified wake models such as Jensen model for active wake control. In this paper, a coordinated optimization strategy of blade pitch and yaw -based control based on an improved Gaussian wake model is proposed to implement the maximization of offshore wind farm output, in which the improved Gaussian wake model is used to model the wake velocity of single unit, and the wake superposition method based on momentum conservation is used to sum the common wake region of multiple units. Regarding the complexity of the established model, the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is applied to obtain optimal yaw angle and axial induction coefficient under the conditions of specific wind direction and speed. Then the virtual parameter axial induction coefficient can be converted into actual variables, namely blade pitch and turbine rotational speed. Case studies are conducted on an ideal offshore wind farm to demonstrate the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed optimization model and approaches utilized.

articleTitle: Research on high altitude multifunctional ice covering test platform
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: In the rapid development process of wind and photovoltaic power generation, the challenges brought by environmental factors affect the safe operation of the system, while also bringing high operation and maintenance costs. This article analyzes the key issues that still need to be solved, such as lightning strikes, icing, and dust accumulation, faced by wind and solar power generation equipment. It studies and develops a high-altitude multifunctional icing test platform, which mainly simulates special environmental tests (strong wind, large temperature difference, icing frost, condensation, high altitude, etc.). At the same time, it can cover insulation tests, material characteristics testing, grid access testing, equipment special assessment, and other tests of transmission and transformation equipment. The R&D and construction of a high-altitude multifunctional icing test platform is a special environmental field power experimental area that integrates scientific research, detection, and engineering applications. It is an important measure to fill the gap in the research field of safety and reliability of new energy equipment and transmission and transformation equipment in extreme environmental conditions in China, challenge ultra-high voltage transmission technology to extreme climate environments, achieve leapfrog development, and support the construction of a strong smart grid.

articleTitle: Energy management of port electric power system under the trajectory optimization of electric quay crane
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: With the continuous increase of maritime trade volume, the energy consumption of ports has also increased. As a major energy consumer in ports, electric quay crane has great potential in energy conservation and emission reduction. In order to improve work efficiency, the quay crane often needs to change the length of the rope while moving horizontally. Therefore, achieving energy efficiency optimization while ensuring the safety and stability of the quay crane movement is an urgent practical problem. This article proposes an optimal energy consumption trajectory planning method, which can reduce both time and energy consumption while theoretically ensuring that the quay crane work process meets system constraints. Firstly, this article sets the critical path points based on the quay crane movement process and uses B-spline curve design to realize the positioning of the target trajectory. Then, using immune algorithm to optimize the time through each path point to minimize the total energy consumption of the system. Finally, the trajectories obtained by this method through quay crane under different working conditions have significant advantages in terms of time and energy consumption compared to the original trajectories, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Development and application of novel sun-tracking control system for parabolic trough solar collector on distributed energy
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: A distributed energy system with multi-source cooperative heating that relies primarily on trough solar thermal heating with high efficiency is designed due to low tracking accuracy in conventional engineering applications, leading to inefficient solar energy utilization. A high-precision mathematical model for single-axis tracking of parabolic troughs is developed based on the solar position algorithm (SPA). The quantitative calculation of operating characteristics and cosine efficiency is carried out, and the influence of the condenser arrangement on system performance is studied. The entire simulation model is built based on System Advisor Model (SAM), using the data from a typical meteorological year. And the performance and economic analysis are accomplished. An automatic tracking strategy with intermittent control considering multi-mode switching and boundary conditions is designed, cooperating with a worm gear reducer to realize the closed-loop real-time tracking of the sun's position by the multi-axis synchronous drive system. High-precision algorithms is realized through embedded programming with a PLC controller. The actual operation data shows that the system has the advantages of high tracking accuracy, simplicity of structure, and convenient maintenance, which are significant for the application of clean energy in the field of distributed heating.

articleTitle: Research on the AC voltage control stability of the renewable energy connected to weak grids
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: To achieve the carbon peak and neutrality goals, the power system is developing towards a power system with higher penetration of renewable power generations. The characteristics of the power electronic converters are different from the traditional synchronous generators which decreases the voltage support cap ability and brings a big challenge to the voltage control stability. Firstly the outer loop analytical transfer function model of the VSC integration system with active power and AC voltage is investigated, considering AC system strength and Phase Locked L oop (PLL) dynamics. Then, the open loop transfer function model of the outer loop AC voltage control (AVC) was derived and divided into two components. One component is the open loop transfer function of outer loop AVC when the AC system strength is infini te. And the other is a modulation function reflecting the influence of AC system strength, active power, PLL and active power control. By analyzing the characteristics of the modulation function, the instability mechanism of outer loop AVC was investigated . And the influence of the factors above on the outer loop AVC stability were discussed. The phenomenon that the AVC instability issue was most serious when PLL and AVC have similar bandwidth was revealed and explained.

articleTitle: An active wake control strategy for a tidal current turbine array
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The hydrodynamics in large tidal current turbine arrays cause their constituent turbines to operate in conditions that are significantly different from those of their isolated counterparts. The complex turbine-wake interactions leading to sub-optimal power generation from most tidal turbines within the array and also results in higher fatigue loading on downstream turbines. This paper presents an array controller which determines the power and load set-points between the turbines based on incoming flow velocity for each turbine. This control methodology enables dynamic response in time-variable flow velocity and trade-off between output power and fatigue loads through the adjustment of pitch angle and rotational speed simultaneously for each turbine. The benefits of this novel control strategy are tested in a 10.5 MW seven-turbine array model which is simulated in MATLAB/Simulink. Results show that under the premise of mitigating fatigue loads, the proposed control strategy is still able to guarantee a high level of power output. Since the temporal variability in tidal current energy increases after applying the proposed control strategy, the power quality at the point of common coupling is assessed. Existing grid standards are used for assessing voltage parameter variations, frequency, and harmonics on both weak and strong grids.

articleTitle: The effectiveness of iron-based additives in enhancing methane and hydrogen production: a systematic review
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The proper treatment of animal manure, sewage biosolids, agricultural by-products, and food waste is becoming increasingly vital due to environmental concerns. Hydrogen is currently regarded as a clean energy source with a high energy density, whereas methane has been utilized extensively. Using anaerobic digestion, biohydrogen and methane are produced. Alternative performance-influencing factors, such as metallic nanoparticles and process optimization, must be identified. Consequently, iron-based materials are inexpensive and effective; however, if the threshold is exceeded, the biological process may be inhibited. This review focuses on analyzing the most recent advancements in the biological process enhanced by iron-based materials, the current state of knowledge, identifying the gaps for future research, methods for studying microbial communities, and promising new materials. It was supplemented by a bibliographic analysis that evaluated the difficulties of large-scale facilities and emphasized the economic implications and strategies for recovering iron-based materials. This article discusses possible future directions for research.

articleTitle: An overview of fault identification techniques in power distribution networks: methods and models
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The reliability of power distribution networks is crucial, as faults can lead to power outages and disrupt daily life. Identifying the causes of these faults is complex, but various methods and models have been proposed for this purpose. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of research on fault identification in power distribution networks, including waveform analysis and machine learning-based methods. Waveform analysis techniques involve studying differences between waveforms for different fault types and developing models, such as arc models and grounding models, to differentiate between faults based on characteristics such as current harmonic content and distortion amount. Machine learning-based methods analyze electrical and weather characteristics to classify faults based on these features. Other fault identification techniques proposed in the literature, such as transient-based, phase plane-based, and wavelet-based methods, are also reviewed. The paper discusses simulation-based validation of fault identification techniques, including the advantages and disadvantages of various simulation techniques and the effectiveness of different techniques in different scenarios.

articleTitle: Fault ride-through control of improved voltage drop method for MMC-HVDC connected renewable energy
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Renewable energy connected to the grid via MMC-HVDC should have fault ride-through (FRT) ability. However, it is difficult to achieve reliable FRT without high-speed and reliable communication between converters in the system. The coefficient of the traditional voltage drop method is qualitatively set as a linear constant, making it difficult to quickly reach the required voltage under different faults. As a result, there are long step delays due to the coordination of converters in the system, which consequently causes the DC system to operate at high voltage during FRT. To address this problem, this paper analyzes the dynamic characteristics of the DC system and the principles of the traditional voltage drop method. Based on this analysis, FRT control of improved voltage drop method for MMC-HVDC connected renewable energy is proposed. Finally, a simulation model is constructed in the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. Additionally, the proposed method is compared with the traditional method. The results demonstrate that the proposed method reduces the step delay and achieves accurate and reliable FRT.

articleTitle: Image-based methods for data centre equipment status monitoring: a review
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Data centres are crucial infrastructures in today's society, but managing and maintaining the multitude of devices and complex operational environments present significant challenges. To address this, researchers have been focusing on developing image-based methods to monitor and detect equipment status abnormalities, leveraging advancements in computer vision and deep learning. This paper provides a comprehensive review and analysis of these methods in data centres, discussing their research status, strengths, limitations, and future directions. It aims to serve as a valuable reference for researchers, promoting the development and application of related research. The paper covers small object detection methods and scene text recognition techniques, encompassing both traditional and deep learning algorithms. It also highlights current challenges and proposes future research directions, aiming to drive comprehensive progress in data centre equipment status monitoring.

articleTitle: An ultra-short-term PV power forecasting method based on groundbased cloud images
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Movement of clouds will directly change solar irradiance, which is the most important factor for instability of PV power. In this thesis, cloud information is obtained through cloud images collected by ground-based sky imager, and an ultra-short-term PV power forecasting method based on cloud images is proposed. Firstly, cloud image pre-processing solve the distortion problem caused by fish-eye lens of the sky imager, restore realistic distribution of clouds and prepare for extraction of feature points of two consecutive frames. Then, cloud motion speed is obtained by matching cloud cluster pixels of two frames of cloud images before and after predicted time. In order to improve the accuracy of speed, a calculation method is proposed based on cloud pattern classification and particle swarm optimization weights for cloud speed prediction. Finally, a model from cloud images to PV power is established. The proposed method is verified with public cloud image data collected by National Autonomous University of Mexico (NAUM), and the outcome is compared with results of two common persistence models. Results show that the proposed method significantly improves forecasting performance in most prediction time ranges.

articleTitle: Analysis of withstand capacity of VSC-HVDC system to background harmonics of grid
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Taking the withstand capacity of the voltage source converter based high voltage dc transmission (VSC-HVDC) system to the background harmonics of the grid as the starting point, this paper first sorts out and compares the relevant requirements of IEC, IEEE and national standards on the background harmonics content of the grid, and gives the distribution level of system background harmonics by taking the 500kV AC system near a back-to-back project site of Guangdong Power Grid as an example. Furthermore, the influence mechanism of the background harmonics of the grid on the VSC-HVDC main equipment and the withstand capacity of the main equipment to the background harmonics are analyzed. Finally, two harmonic suppression control strategies and their respective advantages and disadvantages are proposed, and the effect and correlation analysis of the proposed control strategies are compared and verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Capacity allocation method for a hybrid energy storage system participating in the secondary frequency regulation using variational mode decomposition
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Hybrid energy storage systems (HESSs) are widely used to solve frequency fluctuation problems caused by the uncertainty and volatility of renewable power generation. This paper proposes a capacity configuration method for a HESS participating in the secondary frequency regulation based on variable mode decomposition (VMD). Considering the costs of the HESS's entire lifecycle and the benefit of frequency regulation operation, an economic model of the HESS is constructed to maximize the net income value. The optimal HESS configuration capacity is obtained under the frequency regulation requirements and the constraints of battery operation. The allocation of the HESS is preliminarily determined based on the parameter optimization VMD, and finally decided considering the state of charge of the energy storage. The proposed capacity allocation method is solved using the Gurobi solver in MATLAB. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated with typical historical frequency regulation signal data for a particular region. The results show that the proposed method can optimize the sizing of the battery and ultracapacitor components, and improve the economic efficiency of the HESS participating in the secondary frequency regulation.

articleTitle: Eigen analysis of speed controlling of doubly-fed induction machine based adjustable-speed pumped storage unit
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Doubly Feed Induction Machine based Adjustable Speed Pumped Storage Units(DFIM-ASPSU) due to its advantages of wider operating range, higher efficiency and shorter switching time, it has gained wide attention. In this paper, aiming at the influence of the variation of the parameters of DFIM-ASPSU on the dynamic characteristics of the system speed controlling, a simplified mathematical model of DFIM-ASPSU ignoring the electromagnetic process is established, and then the Eigenvalue analysis method is adopted to obtain the variation trend of the Eigenvalue by using the parameter perturbation method. The analysis results show that, The change of static head has little influence on the stability of rotating speed under power generation conditions. The influence of parameters on the dynamic characteristics of oscillation modes is further studied by using damping ratio and oscillation frequency, and the rationality of theoretical analysis is verified by time domain simulation.

articleTitle: Reactive power and voltage optimization method of distribution network based on reinforcement learning MADDPG algorithm
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: With the maturity of renewable energy generation technologies such as photovoltaic(PV) and wind power, distributed generators are widely connected to the distribution network. Distributed power sources have advantages such as high flexibility, high power generation efficiency, and environmental protection. However, for distribution networks with high penetration rates of distributed power sources, the intermittency and fluctuation of distributed power sources can easily cause voltage exceeding limits in the distribution network. The significance of reactive power optimization in distribution networks lies in maintaining voltage stability by adjusting the distribution of reactive power flow in the system. The traditional physical model-based optimization methods for reactive power and voltage in distribution networks have drawbacks such as imprecise physical models and difficulty in meeting communication conditions. This article proposes a reactive power and voltage optimization method for distribution networks based on the MADDPG algorithm. The MADDPG algorithm trains the reactive power output of PV inverters in the distribution networks. After the training is completed, each agent makes real-time decisions based on local observation datasets, achieving local control of the distribution network voltage. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm are verified through an improved IEEE 33-node system.

articleTitle: Flexibility and performance analysis of cogeneration unit with air-cooled condenser and district heating high back pressure heating system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The flexibility transformation of existing generation units must strictly conform to the regulatory requirements stipulated by the government authorities. The peak regulation capacity of co-generation units is restricted due to the coupling characteristics of thermal-electric production. The model-based software EBSILON was employed for performance simulation of a 660MW supercritical co-generation unit with ACC and high back pressure heating system. The peaking load capability and heating fuel expenditure under three heating modes and various heating load conditions were analysed. To prevent ventilation and excessively elevated temperatures of the LPT final stage blading, the LPT exhaust volumetric flow rate must be meticulously checked. Results indicate that the minimum peaking power output of 207.91MW, 270.25MW is attained under ESH heating mode and HBPH mode respectively, which corresponds to 31.5% and 40.95% of rated load. Based on coal consumption per GJ heating curves established, a priority analysis of three heating modes was conducted. In most circumstances, the three modes are arranged in the order of the optimal economic efficiency: HBPH mode, HBPH+ESH mode, and ESH mode. The peak load regulating capability curves and coal consumption per GJ heating curves will assist to fully harness the peak shaving potential of co-generation unit and accomplish better operation economies.

articleTitle: Load restoration strategy for distribution network considering active power support from public electric taxis
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Effective load restoration strategies for distribution networks are indispensable to reduce power outage loss. With the growing number of public electric taxis (E-taxis), charge stations with plugged-in E-taxis can be considered as potential restoration power sources for the distribution network. In this paper, a load restoration strategy for a distribution network considering active power support from public E-taxis is proposed. The research establishes a fundamental multi-time period distribution network restoration optimization model that includes power flow constraints, topological constraints, and power supply buses' output constraints. Additionally, the output model of the charge station bus considering the plug-in of E-taxis and the integrated restoration optimization model for the distribution network are proposed in sequence. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed methodology is validated through a case study using real distribution network data from Shanghai.

articleTitle: Buck converter-based error analysis of L/C model algorithm in real-time simulation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Hardware-in-the-loop real-time simulation has been increasingly applied for renewable power generation and grid-integration analysis with the involvement of power electronic converters. In this paper, based on a Buck converter, both time- and frequency-domain errors in real-time simulation applying L/C switching model algorithm are analysed. L/C model-based algorithm deal with the power electronic switch as a constant conductance in parallel with a changing current source, through which the simulation duration is essentially decreased compared to the traditional binary resistance (i.e., Ron/Roff) model. However, through L/C model algorithm, the original topology is modified and the transient switching loss is increased. Based on the Buck converter, this paper first analyses the power loss and the steady-state output deviation between the two simulation algorithms. Then, the output impedance of Buck circuit realized in the L/C model algorithm is established for the first time, which presents evidently deviations in low-frequency area compared to the theoretical small-signal linearizing model. Finally, the simulated steady-state output voltage and frequency-scanned output impedance verify the theoretical analyses.

articleTitle: Broadband impedance-based pilot protection for outgoing line of MMC-HVDC converter station
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The output current of the modular multilevel converter (MMC) has the limited amplitude and the controlled phase, resulting in a decrease or even failure of the traditional differential protection sensitivity of MMC- high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission lines. This article extracts the broadband components generated by the sudden changes in the superimposed voltage and current. Firstly, the broadband impedance characteristics of the MMC are analysed, and a broadband impedance model of the MMC is proposed. Then, the broadband impedance characteristics during internal and external faults were analysed, and protection criteria were constructed based on this characteristic. Finally, the broadband impedance-based pilot protection is proposed. The test results indicate that the proposed protection can reliably identify internal and external faults, and is not affected by the control strategy of the MMC.

articleTitle: A secondary control method for economic dispatch of microgrid through distributed time-varying quadratic optimal resource allocation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: This paper proposes a secondary control method for economic dispatch of microgrid through distributed time-varying quadratic optimal resource allocation. The method aims to minimize the operation cost while ensuring the power balance and frequency restoration in the microgrid. Firstly, the droop controlled distributed generator model and secondary control model for economic dispatch are briefly reviewed. Then, this paper utilizes the distributed time-varying quadratic optimization technique to allocate resources optimally among the distributed generators, and proposes a secondary control method for economic dispatch of microgrid. Also, the strict mathematical proof for the control method is given. Finally, the effectiveness of this approach is demonstrated through several case studies.

articleTitle: Directional pilot protection for flexible DC distribution system based on transient high-frequency impedance
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Due to the great performance of connecting distributed power supply and DC load flexibly and efficiently, flexible dc distribution system has been a trend for future distribution grids. However, power electronic devices are difficult to withstand short-circuit impulse current caused by dc line-to-line faults. In this case, it is necessary to identify the fault area within a short time accurately. The influence on high-frequency impedance equivalent model of converters is investigated. On this basis, a directional pilot protection based on transient high-frequency impedance is proposed. This protection regards equivalently fault point as a high-frequency source, utilizes the structural properties of the distribution network to judge direction of the fault, and realizes the fault region identification according to the signals at both ends of the dc line. Finally, the detailed model of a four-terminal flexible dc distribution system is built in PSCAD/EMTDC. The simulation results prove that the proposed protection owns high speed and selectivity while it can withstand distributed capacitance, high transition resistance and system noise.

articleTitle: Low voltage ride through control strategy for doubly fed asynchronous wind turbines based on super-capacitors
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The article analyzed the low voltage ride through principle of doubly fed asynchronous wind turbines, analyzed the transient power optimization control strategy and the control method of the Crowbar protection circuit with parallel dynamic resistors for the low voltage ride through optimization effect of wind turbines, proposed a low voltage ride through control method based on the super-capacitor control strategy, and established a corresponding simulation model in Matlab/Simulink software. Through the simulation results, it can be seen that: The low voltage ride through control strategy based on super-capacitors not only has a significant suppression effect on rotor over-current and DC bus over-voltage, but also increased the reactive power compensation of the unit during the low voltage ride through period to support rapid recovery of the power grid and improve the low voltage ride through capability of the unit.

articleTitle: The construction of "multi-source sharing" power big data intelligent management system driven by the goal of improving quality and efficiency
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: In response to the special action of quality and efficiency improvement proposed by State Grid Corporation of China, State Grid Changzhou Electric Power Corporation carries out the construction of "multi-source sharing" power big data intelligent management system, which integrates load, electricity production, power sales, electricity consumption and other multi-power data, and expands on the basis of regular data analysis to realize the data sharing among government, power supply companies, electricity consumers, etc. This project aims to share data resources in multiple fields and improve the efficiency of power big data utilization. Revolves around multi-source sharing technology, data intelligent analysis technology, big data processing and data management technology, the project achieved the following innovative research results: first, realize the diversification of analysis and management data; second, the proposal of data-physical co-driven electricity consumption prediction technology and characteristics analysis technology of electricity consumption; third, the break through research in power data management technology for different objects; fourth, to realize the intelligent analysis and automatic report generation of big data. The project results will play a key role in improving the management level and service quality of electric power big data and have good demonstration significance.

articleTitle: Offline parameter identification method considering the nonlinear characteristics of grid-connected inverter controller
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The correct model parameters play important role in fault characteristics analysis and protection design. It is a necessity to identify the parameters based on external characteristics due to the problem of parameters black-box. However, existing studies lack concerns in the nonlinear control of the control system during the transient, and cannot analysis the transient characteristics of the converter. Therefore, the inverter parameter identification method based on the dynamic model of phase-locked loop (PLL) is proposed in this paper. It is revealed that the influence of the dynamic process of PLL on the identification model. Considering the dynamic characteristics of PLL, a transient current identification model is established. A parameter identification method based on structural similarity (SSIM) was proposed. Simulation examples show that the proposed parameter identification method can identify parameters accurately.

articleTitle: A synergistic configuration strategy for energy storage systems for deep peak shaving and frequency and inertia response
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: High wind power penetration creates the demand for deep peak shaving (DPS) and frequency and inertia response (FIR) which must be provided by other resources. The former has been provided mainly by thermal units in the past, and the latter by energy storage systems, while the local configuration of energy storage systems in wind farms can absorb excess wind production, providing local DPS and reducing the need for grid-side thermal units to reduce output. In addition, energy storage systems can replace wind power to complete FIR services, helping wind turbines to better connect to the grid. Currently, there is no research on energy storage systems configuration that considers the above two points. To fill this gap, a synergistic configuration strategy for energy storage systems for DPS and FIR is presented that specifically addresses two operational aspects, namely, the local wind absorption and the dynamic frequency response coordinated with other thermal units. The operational simulation is formulated as a mixed-integer second-order cone program. The configuration results and their economic performance with and without energy storage systems participating in DPS and FIR for the IEEE 14-bus system are analysed to prove the advantage of the synergistic configuration.

articleTitle: Sub-synchronous oscillation mitigation of VSC-HVDC with doubly-fed induction generator-based wind farm integration
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The interaction between a double fed induction generator based (DFIG) wind farm and a voltage source converter based HVDC (VSC-HVDC) system may cause the risk of a sub-synchronous oscillation near the rated frequency (NRF-SSO), and the SSO occurs frequently in some practical projects.
