This paper establishes an equivalent system model of DFIGs connected to a VSC-HVDC system. The impedance analytical method is adopted to explore the mechanism of SSO, hence the dominant factors of DFIG and VSC-HVDC impedance in sub-synchronous frequency are studied by simplifying the model. To mitigate the NRF-SSO oscillation, the virtual reactance damping control scheme is proposed to add into the inner loop controller of VSC-HVDC. The influence of damping controller parameters on system stability is studied, and the stability region of parameters is given. Finally, the correctness of the oscillation mechanism and the effectiveness of the damping control strategy are verified by the electromagnetic transient simulation.

articleTitle: A network reconfiguration method of distribution networks considering dynamic characteristics of the distributed renewable energy sources
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The existing research on distribution network restoration control lacks the consideration of the dynamic recovery characteristics of distributed renewable energy sources (dRESs). By taking the output of dRESs as invariant, the voltage of network could be excessive low, which leads to the failure of system restoration. Given this, a restoration control method of distribution network considering the output fluctuation of dRESs is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the dynamic restoration control model of distribution network with dRESs integration is constructed. Then, the Gaussian mutation, which can effectively improve the global search ability and computing speed, are introduced into the traditional Binary Particle Swarm Optimization (BPSO) algorithm. The examples validate that the proposed method can calculate the optimal reconstruction scheme of the dRESs-penetrated distribution network within dozens of seconds. The off-normal voltage and failure reconnection of dRESs can be avoided, boosting the restoration of distribution system.

articleTitle: Inertia control strategy of variable frequency motor actively participating in frequency regulation of microgrid
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that independent AC microgrids are prone to frequency fluctuations due to disturbances, this paper proposes an inertia control strategy of variable frequency motors actively participating in frequency regulation of microgrid. Based on virtual synchronous machine technology on the rectifier side, the control signals on the motor side and the grid side have interacted, so the rotational inertia stored by the asynchronous motor can be utilized to provide frequency support for the microgrid. The speed-frequency droop control is added to the rectifier side to reduce the deviation between the system frequency and the rated frequency at a steady state. At the same time, the electromagnetic torque inertia compensation control is added on the inverter side to limit the dynamic range of the inverter DC voltage. The independent microgrid model is built on the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform. The results show that the strategy proposed in this paper is reliable and effective, and optimizes the frequency stability capability under disturbances of the independent microgrid.

articleTitle: Impacts of grid fault and control parameters on VSG's transient stability
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Under fault conditions, virtual synchronous generators (VSG) may suffer from transient instability, which is similar to the transient instability of a traditional synchronous generator. Grid faults often simultaneously trigger voltage amplitude drops and phase jumps. However, the impact of grid faults and control parameters on the transient stability of VSG is not well understood, especially regarding the effects of phase jumps, which have not been thoroughly explored. To address this, the full-order nonlinear model of a VSG is established in this paper, and then the Lyapunov stability criterion for nonlinear system is constructed by using the TS fuzzy model and linear matrix inequality method. The transient stability regions of the system taking account into the both grid fault conditions and control parameters, are estimated quantitatively. Finally, simulation tests are conducted to validate the theoretical analysis results.

articleTitle: Study on modelling and its parameter identification method of doubly-fed wind turbines LVRT based on measured power response curves
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: With the increasingly prominent energy and environmental problems, wind power generation with its advantages of clean, flexible, sustainable and other advantages in the grid account for an increasing proportion.It is important to study the electromechanical transient model of wind turbine low voltage ride-through (LVRT) and its modeling method based on the measured data to improve the analysis results of the transient response characteristics of wind power grid-connected system to voltage faults. In this paper, based on Doubly-Fed Induction Generator (DFIG), firstly, the dynamic regulation process of converter and generator is ignored, and based on the electromechanical transient model of wind turbine active-reactive power regulation command to stator output active-reactive current respectively, the typical active-reactive power control mode of wind turbine LVRT is studied according to the measured power response curve of LVRT, and the active-reactive power limitation strategy during LVRT. The typical active-reactive power control method of LVRT and the active-reactive power limiting strategy during LVRT are investigated. Then, a method is proposed to identify the fault ride-through control strategy using the characteristic points of the power, voltage and current response curves of the measured voltage fault ride-through. Based on analyzing the main control parameters of the model with the parameter sensitivity, an optimization method based on the least square method is proposed to identify the model parameters step by step. Finally, the validity of the model and the identification method are verified by using Matlab/Simulink simulation and real measurement data, and the robustness of the model is verified by using operating conditions with different degrees of voltage dips.

articleTitle: A pilot protection of high frequency calculated power for flexible low-frequency AC transmission lines connected to off-shore wind farms
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Flexible low-frequency AC transmission technology is an important development direction of offshore wind power transmission, which has the advantages of low impedance and high transmission capacity. The fault component in flexible low-frequency AC transmission systems are no longer dominated by power frequency(50Hz), which may lead to a decrease in the performance of traditional protection schemes. At the same time, with the widespread use of power electronic devices, the control strategy of M3C converter will change the amplitude of fault current, so the pilot protection based on the current in the transmission line has the risk of rejection. In order to solve these problems, a new principle of flexible low frequency AC transmission lines protection based on high frequency calculated power differential is proposed. Based on the high frequency power calculation theory, this principle is calculated by collecting the high frequency instantaneous current and voltage values at both ends of the transmission line. In order to ensure the reliability and selectivity of the protection scheme, a method to set the differential criterion of protection is proposed. Finally, a flexible low-frequency AC transmission line model containing full power wind power system is built on the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme can identify faults correctly and quickly.

articleTitle: Adaptability analysis of current differential protection for renewable energy station outgoing line
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: To achieve carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals, it is necessary to build a new power system with renewable energy as the main body. In this context, the integration of high proportion of renewable energy and high proportion of power electronic equipment imposes stricter requirements on power system relay protection. The current differential protection, as the main protection for the outgoing line of renewable energy stations, has a significant impact on the development and utilization of renewable energy and the stable operation of the power grid. This paper analyses the fault characteristics of the outgoing line for renewable energy stations, and analyses the adaptability of current differential protection using the rewritten criterion and composite sequence network. The influence of different factors on the performance of differential protection operation is verified through the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation model.

articleTitle: Analysis of a real-world oscillation stability event in a power system with high penetration of renewables
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: A subsynchronous oscillation event was observed in a power system with high penetration of renewables in North-East China. The impact of this oscillation event is extensive, and it was observed at substations distributed in different locations. This paper analyses the characteristics based on the field-measured data. Firstly, the operation conditions are described, and oscillation frequencies are analysed. Then, the characteristics of the oscillation are revealed by the field-recorded data. The impedance of wind generators and transmission lines is calculated. The results show that the photovoltaic plant presents negative resistance and the interaction between it and the weak grid cause unstable sub/super-synchronous oscillation. Finally, it is shown that this oscillation event has a diffusion trend in the target system by the oscillation information.

articleTitle: Timescale-matching based modeling of wind turbine generators for power system stability analysis
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: With the high penetration of wind power, stability of power system poses emerging challenges such as oscillations with wide band frequency, loss of synchronization, voltage and frequency instability, etc. The modelling of dynamic behaviour of wind turbine generators (WTGs) are necessary for stability evaluation of power systems. Detailed model including all components has high orders, which is not suitable for the system-level stability analysis. This paper proposed a timescale matching based modelling method for different stability studies of the power system with large-scale wind turbine integration. Taking permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSGs) as the example, timescales and disturbance types are considered to evaluate the relevance between PMSG components and stability issues. Then, components related to different stability studies are selected to construct the stability-match model. Based on this modelling method, four types of simplified PMSG models are proposed in correspondence to different stability issues respectively. The accuracy and efficiency of the proposed modelling method are validated with different stability scenarios based on comparison of the simplified and detailed models.

articleTitle: Application of the method combining transient earth voltage and ultrasonic detection technology in insulation detection of the high voltage switchgear
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: It is an important topic on how to effectively monitor the internal insulation status of high-voltage switchgear to avoid faults, with the widespread use of high-voltage switchgear in power systems.Based on this, a detection technique combining Transient Earth Voltage(TEV) and ultrasonic detection technology is proposed. Firstly, the principles are introduced.Then, the specific methods of detecting data analysis and fault location are given. Finally, the effectiveness of this technology is illustrated through a case study.

articleTitle: Optimized power dispatching method for a wind farm during de-loading operation to participate in power system frequency regulation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: With the dramatic increase in wind power penetration level (WPPL), wind farms (WFs) must actively participate in power system frequency regulation and tend to operate in a dispatchable way, including wind curtailment if necessary. This paper proposes an optimized power dispatching method for a WF during a de-loading operation. The WF control center collects wind speed information of each wind turbine and creates several groups, including wind turbines with similar wind speeds. The power regulation tasks to each group are allocated, considering both maximizing the rotational kinetic energy of wind turbines with lower wind speeds and reducing the pitching activation frequencies. An optimized combination of over-speeding control and pitch angle control is used to control wind turbines. To validate the performance of the proposed method, the simulations based on the EMTP-RV simulator are implemented by considering different wind speeds, system disturbance severities, and WPPLs. As a comparison, simulation results based on the conventional uniform order-sharing method are also presented and compared with those of the proposed method. The results show that the proposed method performs better in increasing system frequency regulation ability and reducing pitching activation frequency.

articleTitle: Study on ferromagnetic resonance characteristics and suppression measures of 10 kV distribution network
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Ferromagnetic resonance often occurs in distribution networks with ungrounded neutral points due to transient impacts. Under different parameter combinations, fundamental resonance, frequency-dividing resonance and high-frequency resonance can be generated. On the basis of theoretical analysis of the mechanism of ferromagnetic resonance, this paper uses electromagnetic transient simulation software to build a 10kV distribution system, and explores the effects of line length, potential transformer (PT) excitation resistance, and ground fault recovery time on ferromagnetic resonance; The suppression effect of arc suppression coil, harmonic suppression resistance, and improving PT excitation characteristic on ferromagnetic resonance is also analyzed.

articleTitle: Synergistic control-based control strategy for optimizing the coordinated inertia support of wind farms to the receiving grid via VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of inertia reduction of the receiving power grid caused by feeding new energy source, an inertia coordination control optimization strategy for wind farm via VSC-HVDC based on cooperative control is proposed. Firstly, this paper analyzes the feasibility of coupling the voltage regulation of DC transmission line with the variation of wind farm frequency, which makes the wind farm sensing the frequency disturbance in the receiving power grid without communication. Based on synergetic control theory, a synergetic control law for the frequency-DC voltage droop coefficient of GSVSC is designed, enabling the DC capacitance to respond to the frequency change rate and quickly provide inertia support at the beginning stage of the disturbance. Further, the synergetic control law for wind farm variable proportional coefficient is also designed to make the inertia provided by the rotor kinetic energy of wind turbines in this strategy synergistically respond to frequency change and the voltage change of DC transmission line, which optimizes the inertia response and helps restore the rotor speed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed adaptive coefficient control strategy is verified by comparing with the fixed coefficient control strategy.

articleTitle: Security-constrained optimal power flow with active support from the grid-forming renewable energy stations
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The high penetration of renewable sources poses higher demand for flexibility to the power system and leaves it with a lack of flexibility regulation capacity, threatening its operational security. This paper explores the active support capacity of renewable energy stations integrated with energy storage and interfaced with converters to compensate for the lack of system regulation resources. Both frequency and voltage regulation capacities of the renewable energy stations are modeled considering the active and reactive power control strategies of the grid-forming converters. A security-constrained optimal power flow is used to host the active support of the renewable energy station in the day-ahead scheduling. The convex relaxation technique is applied to reformulate the regulation model to facilitate the solution progress. A case study on a modified IEEE 6-node system demonstrates that the proposed model guarantees the system's frequency and voltage security.

articleTitle: Dynamic and accurate monitoring method of precast cabin environment based on particle trace
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Accurate dynamic monitoring of precast environment is conducive to the safe and stable operation of substation, and it is also the basis of environmental control system optimization. In this paper, a precise dynamic monitoring method of precast cabin environment based on particle trace method is proposed. The influence of critical environmental parameters is evaluated through thermal theoretical calculation. Based on the location of environmental sensors in the cabin, the characteristics of different control modes under the same environment and load are compared by simulation calculation. Then, a more reasonable control mode is obtained based on the engineering practice, and the control mode is optimized. Finally, through technical and economic analysis, the optimal precast environment dynamic accurate monitoring scheme is determined.

articleTitle: Study on commutation failure of multi-infeed system using hardware-in-the-loop simulation platform
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: In the multi-infeed line commutated converter based high-voltage direct current (LCC-HVDC) transmission system, the complex coupling between the AC and DC system and different LCC-HVDC transmission system causes the commutation failure pattern to change, which makes the control and protection system of LCC-HVDC face challenges. In this paper, the fault characteristics of the multi-infeed line commutated converter based high-voltage direct current (LCC-HVDC) transmission system under different DC system transmission power and different SCR conditions are simulated, and the commutation failure situation and commutation failure prediction action of the system are obtained. The results show that the larger the SCR, the smaller the system transmission power, the smaller the fluctuation of AC voltage after the failure of the AC system, and the smaller the interaction between DC systems.

articleTitle: Configuration method for DC capacitor of VSG-based inverter interfaced energy storage considering the ramping rate of battery
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The DC capacitor and battery provide the inertia support for virtual synchronous generator (VSG)-based inverter interfaced energy storage (IIES). However, the ramping rate of battery restricts its inertial support ability, which has influence on the configuration for DC capacitor of IIES. This paper proposes a configuration method for DC Capacitor considering the ramping rate of battery. The small signal model of IIES in is established with frequency disturbance. The maximum output inertial energy of VSG responding to the frequency disturbance is quantified under the critical damping state. The inertial energy of battery considering the ramping rate and the inertial energy of DC capacitor are equal to the maximum output inertial energy of VSG with the loss ignored, and thus calculating the DC capacitance. The effectiveness of the configuration method is verified by simulation results in different scenarios.

articleTitle: Energy optimization dispatch method for PV and BESS integrated fast charging stations with V2G
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: As an effective way to promote the usage of electric vehicles (EVs) and facilitate the consumption of distributed energy, the optimal energy dispatch of PV and battery energy storage systems (BESS) integrated fast charging stations with V2G is of considerable value to the efficient use of renewable energy. Based on an examination of the operation modes of PV and BESS integrated fast charging stations, considering the randomness of EVs' arrival and departure, a rolling optimization strategy is adopted. Combining the energy architecture characteristics of the charging stations, the economic dispatch model is established by scheduling the orderly charging and discharging of EVs with a view to minimizing the expense of daily operations. In view of the shortcomings of the first-stage economic dispatch, two further optimization strategies are proposed to level out the power fluctuation of the grid connection point (POC) of the charging station, and the effect of the two-stage optimization model and the multi-objective optimization model are studied in comparison. Finally, the economic index and power fluctuation index are analyzed by using an actual charging station as a case study.

articleTitle: Analysis and optimization of sparse LU factorization of power matrix based on GLU
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of power grid stability and reliability requirements, improving the efficiency and accuracy of power system simulation has become an important research topic. The sparse LU factorization is one of the key modules of the sparse direct solver, which usually plays a dominant role in the solving time of the sparse linear algebra equation of power system. In order to improve the efficiency of sparse LU factorization, we propose: 1) an adaptive mode partition strategy based on GLU, and select the mode to be used according to the characteristics of the matrix to be decomposed, which improves the computational efficiency of LU factorization; 2) a dynamic Nstream value taking method for the stream pattern, which determines the number of streams to be used based on the dimensions of the sub-matrix, 3) a pipeline model for the continuous layer with the size of 1 in GLU, which improves the parallelism of sparse LU factorization and helps to improve the computing efficiency. The results show that the proposed improvement can achieve better results, and the speed of LU factorization is increased by more than 30% on rajat12 and circuit_2.

articleTitle: Research on primary frequency regulation control strategy of flywheel energy storage assisted thermal power unit based on VMD decomposition
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: A large number of renewable energy sources are connected to the grid, which brings great challenges to the frequency of power system. Therefore, a primary frequency regulation control strategy of flywheel energy storage assisted thermal unit is proposed. Firstly, the advantages of flywheel energy storage are used to compensate for the slow frequency response of thermal power units. Variational mode decomposition (VMD) is designed to decompose the power signal lacking in the then high and low frequency signals are allocated to the flywheel energy storage and thermal power units respectively. Pelican optimization algorithm (POA) is used to optimize the decomposition mode number K and penalty factor α in the VMD algorithm. Secondly, the energy storage output is limited by considering the state of charge (SOC) and state of health (SOH) energy storage due to the high cost of flywheel energy storage, and the adaptive control of combined fire-storage frequency regulation is realized. Finally, the simulation of random disturbance load is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the energy storage works in conjunction with thermal power plants during the primary frequency control of the system.

articleTitle: Research on complementary operation method based on oblique photography and laser radar technology
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: This is a brand new operation method, with one innovation being the use of a self-developed oblique photography high-density route planning method to restructure the high-precision physical model of the substation. Then, a point cloud data model of the substation is collected using LiDAR, and the two are combined through software to form a solid point cloud model. Based on the solid point cloud model, route planning is mainly carried out for the low altitude areas and surrounding environment of the substation, which can ensure that the texture details of the substation equipment are more recognizable and that the linear texture details of high-altitude grounding wires are clearer. The second innovation is the use of high-definition physical models for the first time to conduct three-dimensional investigation of hidden dangers of foreign objects floating around substations, efficiently and intuitively identifying hidden dangers, saving personnel and labor. The third innovation point is that based on the entity point cloud model, optimized intelligent model algorithms are implanted to achieve intelligent automatic generation of autonomous flight routes. Combining the above innovative methods, drones are ensured to be more efficient, accurate, and reliable in terms of inspection points, safety strategies, and navigation optimization.

articleTitle: State space modelling and stability analysis of DFIG wind farm integrated through VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: In the interconnected system of doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) wind farm and voltage source converter-based high-voltage direct current (VSC-HVDC), the sub-synchronous oscillation caused by the interaction between power electronic equipment and flexible DC transmission system occasionally occurs, which will endanger the safety and stability of the power systems. In order to reveal the mechanism of the above types of electrical oscillations, this paper extends the DFIG grid-connected state space model to a 24 orders detailed state space model considering DFIG connected with wind farm side VSC (WF-VSC) system. Then, the dominant state variables that affect the interconnected oscillation modes are identified by participation factor analysis. In addition, the influence of the operating point, controller, and electrical parameters on the stability of the interconnected system is analyzed based on the eigenvalue method. The analysis results show that the controller is crucial to stability, especially for the WF-VSC station. The conclusion of stability analysis is also verified by time domain simulation.

articleTitle: Protection strategy for fault detection in transmission lines for DC microgrid
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Fault protection is one of the most common problems in power systems. The problem is finding an accurate and appropriate method for detecting faults in the DC Microgrid's electrical transmission lines and components. Most studies and scientific research focus on solving this problem by designing an appropriate method to solve faults in transmission lines and the rest of the DC Microgrid system. The main reason for finding the proper approach to solve these faults is that the DC Microgrid system contains power electronic devices such as a voltage source converter (VSC) & DC-DC Converter, which impact power loads. This paper presents a protection strategy to detect a fault in DC Microgrid transmission lines. Different faults have been designed, and simulation is done in MATLAB/SIMULINK. Results are obtained using this strategy, which can detect faults in the system and protect DC Microgrid.

articleTitle: An investigation of vehicle-to-building technology through the analysis of real-world applications
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: This paper comprehensively evaluates Vehicle-to-Building (V2B) technology by analysing real case studies. By examining multiple cases from different regions, the study investigates the practical applications and benefits of V2B technology. The case studies cover V2B aspects, including tariff reduction, power outage resilience, and demand response capabilities. The findings demonstrate that V2B technology offers diverse opportunities to enhance grid reliability, reduce energy costs, and empower customers. Furthermore, the analysis highlights the significance of customer-centric business models prioritizing ease of use and flexibility. Moreover, the paper emphasizes that while monetary gains are substantial, the non-monetary benefits of V2B technology, such as information and customer experience, hold equal importance in the evolving V2B market. Additionally, the potential impact of electric vehicle (EV) growth, battery advancements, and renewable energy incentives on the viability and applicability of V2B technology is discussed. Finally, despite challenges such as current battery prices and degradation, early implementation of V2B programs can pave the way for developing new regulations and technologies, unlocking further benefits and innovative business models associated with V2B technology. Overall, this evaluation offers valuable insights into the feasibility of V2B technology, contributing to ongoing discussions and future research in this field.

articleTitle: Challenges and prospect of relay protection in power grids with large-scale renewable power
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: With the application of large-scale renewable power generation and power electronic equipment, the fault characteristics of power grids have been significantly altered. Unlike synchronous generators, the fault characteristics of power electronics are primarily determined by their control strategy, resulting in reduced adaptability of traditional protection methods. Therefore, it is imperative to re-evaluate the requirements of relay protection technology to cope with the evolving power grid. This paper offers a perspective on the future trends and research directions of protection technology for power grids with large-scale renewable power generation. The discussion covers three key aspects: analysis of fault characteristics, adaptation of traditional protection methods, and technology to improve protection performance.

articleTitle: Analysis and handle of power supply monitoring relay fault in main transformer cooling system of nuclear power plant
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: This paper introduces the frequent failures of the power monitoring relay in the air-cooled control cabinet of the main transformer in the nuclear power plant. According to the on-site failure phenomenon and the investigation of the peer power plant, the abnormal problems of the power monitoring relay are analyzed and dealt with. Through in-depth analysis of the loop principle, the relay fault is quickly located, and the relay disassembly inspection and component V-I curve inspection, it is determ ined that the damage of the safety gauge capacitor in the relay is the cause of the fault. On this basis, the capacitor is disassembled and combined with the field operating environment, it is determined that the high temperature operating environment is t he root cause of the frequent failures of the relay.

articleTitle: Protection scheme for the flexible DC transmission based on the calculated impedance of converter
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The flexible DC transmission system based on modular multilevel converter (MMC) responds quickly, and the control signal changes rapidly after DC fault. This paper analyzes the response characteristics of current control signal and voltage control signal in the MMC after a fault, and proposes a new protection scheme for flexible DC transmission lines based on calculated impedance. The calculated impedance is defined by the current and voltage control signals, the response characteristics of the calculated impedance after the fault are analyzed. The converters at both ends exchange the action logic signal to realize the accurate identification of the fault line. The scheme considers the difference of different control strategies, integrates the fault information of the AC and DC sides, and realizes the fault identification through the control signal in the MMC control module, which is simple to implement and has high reliability. The simulation results show that the proposed protection can adapt to different operating modes, and has strong resistance to transition resistance and noise.

articleTitle: Research on standardization of information security of renewable energy power generation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Under the context of national energy security and strategies for carbon emissions peak and carbon neutralization, the importance of information security in the construction of new power systems for renewable energy cannot be overlooked. This paper aims to analyze the current state of information security standardization in the renewable energy power generation field. By doing so, it identifies the existing risks and proposes development plans for the relevant standards.

articleTitle: An improved transient stability control method for virtual synchronous inverters considering virtual impedance
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The grid-connected virtual synchronous generators (VSG) may be burned out due to the rapidly rising fault current when transient faults occur in the grid. Virtual impedance can effectively suppress the fault impulse current of the grid-connected VSG, and prevent them from burning out due to overcurrent. However, the virtual impedance reduces the power transmission capacity of the VSG, which increases the risk of transient synchronization instability. To solve this problem, an improved virtual impedance control method is proposed to improve the transient synchronization stability of the VSG. Firstly, the equivalent model of the VSG considering virtual impedance control is established, and the mechanism of transient synchronization instability caused by virtual impedance is revealed. Secondly, the influence of the parameters on the transient synchronization stability of the VSG is analysed. It reveals that the virtual impedance has a negative impact on the transient synchronization stability. Finally, to improve the transient stability of the VSG, an improved virtual impedance control method based on adaptive power adjustment is proposed. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by PSCAD/EMTDC simulation.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimal operation of integrated regional energy systems with P2G
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: In the context of low carbon environmental protection and energy scarcity, the regional integrated energy system, which combines various energy sources such as electricity, heat, and gas, has become the primary means of energy conservation and emission reduction. To enhance the environmental protection and economic efficiency of the regional integrated energy system, this paper presents an optimal dispatching model of the system with P2G technology. Firstly, a system model including electricity to gas conversion, energy storage, and multiple energy coupling devices is constructed, along with appropriate constraints. Secondly, to address the issues of most current regional integrated energy systems that only focus on environmental pollution or economic benefits, this study establishes economic and environmental indicators as objective functions. The system model is solved with the aid of the particle swarm algorithm, under the condition of considering both aspects. Three scenarios are created to validate the effectiveness of the model. Finally, through simulation analysis, the results demonstrate that the proposed regional integrated energy system model can effectively achieve energy conservation, emission reduction, and enhance comprehensive benefits.

articleTitle: A review of key technologies of shore power systems
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The shore power system is able to replace the ship's fuel oil power generation with clean electricity, reducing the greenhouse gas emissions during ship berthing. With the integration of large-scale renewable power generation into the power system, there are still some key issues of the shore power system to be resolved. In this paper, a comprehensive review of the key technologies of shore power systems is presented. Firstly, this paper summarizes the system topological structure of the shore power system with increasing penetration of renewables. Then, the shore power system standards and the load transfer strategy are summarized. Finally, the wireless power transfer technology for ship charging is reviewed. The research can provide a reference for the operation of shore power systems.

articleTitle: Voltage safety risk assessment of low and medium voltage distribution networks with high proportions of distributed photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The carbon peaking and carbon neutrality Strategies objective is driving the rapid development of distributed photovoltaics (PVs), and at the same time, driven by the "whole county rooftop PVs" policy, a large number of distributed PVs are connected to the county grid. However, the access of large-scale distributed PVs have a great impact on the operation of the distribution network. The impact is characteristically different for different voltage levels. In this paper, OpenDSS software is used to simulate and model the typical middle and low voltage distribution network of Hebei Northern Power Grid. The difference effect of multiple voltage levels of the same feeder is analyzed after the large-scale access of distributed power sources with different nodes and different capacities. Deal with the influence of voltage over-limit caused by different voltage levels of the same feeder., suitable voltage safety assessment indices are proposed to assess the voltage risks ofhigh proportions of distributed PVs to the distribution system.

articleTitle: Aggregation reduced-order modeling of grid-connected multi-converter system for transient stability analysis
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Under large disturbances (e.g., grid sag, power step), the grid-connected system using phase-locked loop (PLL) as the synchronization unit is easy to lose the synchronization so that the transient stability is endangered. In order to facilitate the integration of large-scale renewable energies, it is very important to precisely examine the stability of grid-connected multi-converter system under large disturbances. As proved, the system transient stability depends on the converter with the worst stability (named as the critical converter) in the system. However, the judgment of critical converter is a complex and time-consuming task for multi-converter system. In this study, in order to simplify the transient stability analysis and quickly examine the multi-converter system, an aggregation reduced-order model based on averaging the impedance voltage drop is established. The reduced-order inverter and its aggregated parameters for representing the multi-converter system are obtained. Then, the transient stability of the system represented by the aggregation reduced-order model is compared to the original full-order system. Finally, the accuracy of the model is verified by simulations.

articleTitle: Study on the characteristics and suppression measures of spatial transient electromagnetic field generated by the operation of isolating switch in air insulated substation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: With the construction of strong smart grid, the spatial transient electromagnetic disturbance caused by the operation of isolating switch in Air Insulated Substation (AIS) is becoming more and more important. At present, most of the researches on electromagnetic disturbance are aimed at the measurement of a certain point in a substation, and the relevant researches show that the current national standards can not realize the effective experimental examination of the relevant electromagnetic compatibility characteristics of different secondary equipment. Based on the 330kV real model simulation experiment platform, this paper studies the distribution characteristics of the spatial transient electromagnetic field generated by the operation of the isolating switch in AIS power station. At the same time, the three-dimensional electromagnetic field simulation model is established, and the suppression effect of installing shielding cabinet on transient electromagnetic field in space is also analyzed.

articleTitle: Quantitative risk assessment of island distribution cyber physical system incorporating the fault of cyber system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Driven by the dual carbon target, the distribution system will incorporate a high proportion of renewable energy, and island operation will become an important way of fault recovery. In order to study the influence of cyber system fault on island state distribution network, this paper first analyzes the transmission process of cross fault from cyber space to physical space, and gives the set of expected faults of cyber system caused by natural aging and cyber attack. Then, considering the randomness of distributed generation output and load power as well as the calculation efficiency, the probability model of islanding operation state is established by using multi-scenario technology. Then, the safety risk index and calculation method of planned islanding operation considering cyber system failure are proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed risk calculation method is verified by an example, and the research results can provide effective technical support for the planning and operation of distribution cyber physical system.

articleTitle: A review of fault diagnosis techniques for high-voltage disconnect switches
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: High-voltage disconnect switches are commonly installed in power systems with high fault frequencies. The timely and accurate diagnosis of mechanical faults in high-voltage disconnect switches is crucial to improve the operational stability of power systems and the intelligence level of substations. This paper presents the basic process of diagnosing faults in high-voltage disconnect switches, discusses the current research status of fault diagnosis methods from three perspectives: signal acquisition, feature extraction, and fault identification, and explores typical problems and development directions in the field of high-voltage disconnect switch fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Day-ahead scheduling of islanded microgrid considering optimal reserve capacity provided by energy storage
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: To ensure the safe and economy operation of the isolated microgrid, this paper proposes a day-ahead scheduling model of the islanded microgrid. In the model, the units of the islanded grid include the wind farm (WF), photovoltaic power (PV), energy storage (ES), diesel generator and load. Considering decreasing the expensive generation cost and carbon emission caused by the diesel generator, the ES in the swapping station is utilized to shifting the energy. In addition to provide reserve capacity caused by the prediction error of WF, ES and loaf, the ES also share the battery energy with the ships in the island. When the reserve capacity is not sufficient to cover the prediction error, the remaining insufficient capacity, which can be calculated by the means of superquantile theory in this study, should be compensated by the diesel generator to ensure power supply-demand balance. Based on the solution of the built linear programming model, the operating strategy and the economic analysis of the islanded microgrid combined with multiple units are investigated. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of providing reserve capacity to counter the power imbalance.

articleTitle: 3D stereo imaging technology for GIS interior structure based on multi-angle X-ray images
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Due to the convenient maintenance and small footprint of Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS), GIS has become the most important and widely used power equipment in the power system. However, due to issues such as installation and manufacturing processes, defects may occur inside GIS. Currently, X-ray scanning of the internal structure of GIS is mainly used to locate internal defects. However, X-ray imaging has the vision requirement for the shape and angle of insulation defects. Therefore, internal defects of the GIS parallel to the shooting angle of X-ray cannot be effectively detected. This paper presents a device for collecting X-ray projection sequences. The 3D stereoscopic images of key components of GIS are reconstructed from X-ray projections with different angle. By comparing the obtained 3D model with the normal 3D model, rapid positioning of abnormal parts within the GIS is achieved. This method effectively avoids the cost of disassembling and inspecting internal defects in GIS, and improves the practical effect of locating internal anomalies in GIS.

articleTitle: Optimal charging guidance strategy for electric vehicles based of mixed integer linear programming
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: As the global transition towards sustainable energy gains momentum, electric vehicles (EVs) are progressively replacing conventional fuel vehicles due to their utilization of clean energy. However, the rapid proliferation of EVs has led to a significant disparity between the number of vehicles and the availability of charging infrastructure, resulting in strain on the fast charging demands of EVusers. This research presents a novel EVcharging guidance strategy based on a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) model. The strategy establishes a time optimization modelfor EVs and charging piles, ensuring accurate and reliable data through meticulous cleaning and processing. Specific constraint conditions are defined for both EVs and charging piles, providing a structured framework for the guidance strategy. A simulation experiment is conducted in a designated area in Shanghai to evaluate the feasibility and practicality of the proposed approach. The objective of this study is to optimize the charging process, improve efficiency, and enhance user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic inverter model parameter testing method based on on-site operation data and hardware in the loop testing
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: As the penetration rate of new energy increases, the interactions between new energy power stations and grid are becoming stronger. GB 38755-2019 "Code on security and stability for power system" clarifies new requirements for photovoltaic power generation from the perspective of power systems. Accurate photovoltaic power station models are the basis for conducting photovoltaic grid connection analysis, and have significant practical applications for analyzing photovoltaic power station access to power systems. Currently, the electromechanical transient model parameters of photovoltaic inverters are obtained based on laboratory parameter test data, without considering the optimization of photovoltaic inverter parameters under different grid conditions on site, resulting in significant deviations between the existing photovoltaic inverter model external characteristics and the on-site photovoltaic inverter operating characteristics of the power station. Therefore, this paper specifies the photovoltaic inverter model parameter requirements based on the power system simulation analysis requirements, proposes a photovoltaic inverter model parameter testing method based on on-site operation data and hardware in the loop testing. carries out key parameter identification based on particle swarm optimization algorithm. Finally, the correctness and feasibility of the proposed parameter testing method is verified based on a photovoltaic power station case in northwest China.

articleTitle: Research on the reactive power and voltage characteristics of flexible low- frequency transmission systems for offshore wind power
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Low-frequency transmission technology has been considered to be suitable for medium and long distance offshore wind power integration. However, frequency changes alter the characteristics of the offshore wind power transmission system, and the reactive power and voltage relationship of the offshore wind power low-frequency transmission system is not yet clear. In this paper, the nodal voltage method is used to analyse the system steady state power flow calculation, establish a mathematical model of the reactive power and voltage of the offshore wind power low-frequency transmission system under different output conditions of the wind farm, and analyse the static reactive power and voltage characteristics of the system.Finally, based on the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform, the accuracy of the mathematical model is verified by using a 500kV/800MW offshore wind farm low-frequency transmission system as an arithmetic example.

articleTitle: Impact of wind farm wake steering control on blade root load
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Yaw misalignment is known to affect blade root loads on wind turbines. Most of previous studies concentrate on yaw misalignment in the context of wake steering control, aiming at increasing the total output power of the wind farm. There, wake steering is compared with greedy control, in which yaw misalignment is considered to be 0. In reality, yaw misalignment also occurs in greedy control due to changes in wind direction arising from varying inflow conditions (e.g. turbulence). This paper aims at comparing these two sources of yaw misalignment-naturally changing wind direction versus active yaw in wake steering-in terms of blade root loads. To this end, SCADA data from a real wind farm is used to get yaw misalignment statistics in actual greedy control conditions. FAST.Farm is used to simulate three wind turbines arranged in series, to study maximum and damage-equivalent loads corresponding to in-plane and out-of-plane bending moments on the blades. The results show that compared with actual greedy control, wake steering control reduces the maximum load from the upstream wind turbine, but increases it from other wind turbines. Concerning the damage-equivalent loads from all wind turbines, the blade's in-plane moment is reduced, but the blade's out-of-plane moment is increased.

articleTitle: High voltage active filter technology for high voltage DC converter station
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: With the proposal of the "dual carbon" goal, large scale developm ent and grid connection of new energy will become a trend, and a large number of power electronic equipment will bring certain operational risks to the safety and stability of the syst em. As one of the main ways to optimize the allocation of energy resourc es in China, DC transmission technology will continue to play a leading role in energy transmission in the future. However, traditional DC systems that rely on AC voltage strength, poor independence and adaptability, and high resonance risk also face enorm ous challenges. Based on this, this article proposes the active filter technology for high voltage converter stations and conducts research from various aspects such as topology structure, working principle, scheme design, and engineering application. The research conclusion shows that this technical solution can enhance the adaptability of traditional DC to weak AC systems, improve harmonic characteristics, optimize converter station layout, and effectively support the strength of AC systems. This provides necessary guidance for the design of DC transmission engineering systems in the context of the development of future new power systems.

articleTitle: Net load forecasting and energy storage demand analysis for renewable energy integration
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: This study investigates net load forecasting under different penetration levels of photovoltaic power and various mix scenarios of wind and photovoltaic power. The SARIMAX (Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average with Exogenous Inputs) model is employed for forecasting, and energy storage demand is calculated based on the maximum absolute deviation between predicted and actual net load. Results indicate that higher penetration levels of renewable energy lead to reduced prediction accuracy and increased peak energy storage demand. Additionally, increasing the proportion of solar power, characterized by higher output uncertainty, amplifies the need for energy storage. These findings emphasize the significance of accurate net load forecasting and the role of energy storage in effectively managing power systems with extensive renewable energy integration.

articleTitle: Parameter optimization of LCL-type grid-connected inverter filter in weak power grid using NSGA-II algorithm
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Grid-connected inverters with LCL-type filters are often used in grid connections of renewable power generation to suppress multiple harmonics in the grid. To effectively alleviate the resonance problem, the method of increasing damping is often used. However, the parameter design of the filter have more restrictions, leading to expensive computation and poor accuracy. In addition, due to the weak conditions of power grid, it is necessary to consider the control system's safety and robustness. Therefore, a multi-objective optimization algorithm based on the NSGA-II algorithm is proposed to design and identify the best filter parameters. Through numerical simulation case studies, the proposed method demonstrates the harmonic suppression ability and weak network resistance of the filter, which verifies its effectiveness and robustness.

articleTitle: Combined analysis of wind speed and lightning activity for wind farms over the East Asian region
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Renewable wind power generation is booming in East Asian countries, such as China, Japan, Mongolia, etc. The operating statistics have listed lightning as a major threat to wind turbines as their exceptional height and large lightning-attraction area. Wind farms are seeking site locations with both superior wind sources and low lightning density. However, it is still lacking the combined analysis of wind speed and lightning activity up to date. This work gathers wind speed data over the East Asian region from satellite measurements and lightning activity data from a ground-based lightning detection network. Atlas of wind speed and lightning activity are drawn over the East Asian region. The relationship between wind speed and lightning activity is also studied and a significant correlation is identified. The results of this work contribute to offering useful information for wind turbines.

articleTitle: A transient damping method of virtual synchronous generators for synchronization stability enhancement
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The virtual synchronous generator (VSG) which can emulate the typical synchronous generator (SG) dynamic has been used to improve the dynamic performance and stability of inverter-based resources (IBRs). However, VSG can encounter the large-disturbance instability during grid voltage fluctuations or faults. During the transient, the power angle of VSG may overshoot or even diverge due to the poor damping, and VSG may still lose the synchronization with the grid and become unstable if the transient damping is insufficient, despite the existence of equilibrium points. Hence, it is of vital importance to improve the damping and stability of VSG during the transient. Therefore, this study aims to propose a transient stability enhancement method for VSG. The technique of three consecutive sampling points (3CS) is utilized for frequency detection, and an additional branch from the output of 3CS is added in the active power control loop. It will be shown that the VSG employing such method behaves satisfactory transient damping while the steady-state behaviour is hardly affected. Detailed theoretical stability analysis and simulation results are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Artificial intelligent adjustment method of power flow convergence for large-scale power grid based on knowledge graph
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that manual experience is difficult to describe accurately and manual participation is high in the process of power flow convergence adjustment, an artificial intelligent adjustment method of power flow convergence for large-scale power grid based on knowledge graph is proposed. First, the adjustment processes commonly used, effective adjustment methods and adjustment rules which specifications to be followed are classified and extracted as knowledge. Furthermore, triples are used to represent different types of knowledge. On this basis, the organization of the knowledge graph is designed to form the power flow convergence adjustment knowledge graph. Then, the knowledge graph judges the state of the power grid according to the data characteristics, so as to select and execute the corresponding adjustment operations, and finally realize the intelligent adjustment of the power flow of the large power grid. The CEPRI 36-node system and the actual system of the ten thousand-node power grid in Northwest and East China were used to verify the correctness, effectiveness and versatility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Flexible power control of PV grid-connected quasi-Z source inverter under unbalanced faults
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Under unbalanced grid voltages, the currents injected into the grid become non-sinusoidal and unbalanced. The unbalanced grid current and voltage may lead to double-frequency oscillations in the active and reactive power. This paper proposes a flexible power control method for the quasi-Z source inverter in PV grid-connected systems under unbalanced conditions. The proposed control strategy can inject a sinusoidal current and mitigate the double-frequency oscillation of the active or reactive power delivered to the network. Furthermore, an easy-to-implement current limitation strategy is proposed to protect the power converter and deliver maximum power to the grid. A non-MPPT mode is triggered to handle the injected current under severe faults. Finally, simulation results are presented to validate the theoretical analysis and controller design.

articleTitle: A nonlinear model predictive control strategy for a wave-to-wire model of vibro-impact wave energy converters
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: In this study, the application of nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) on a wave-to-wire (W2W) model of vibro-impact wave energy converters (VIWECs) is investigated. A nonlinear model predictive control strategy is proposed, for maximising wave energy capture and regulating the varying VIWEC power output as stable DC power. The optimal power take-off (PTO) force, viewed as a control input for maximising wave energy capture, is generated by the NMPC strategy, and actuated by a AC/DC converter with the space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) technique. In addition, a hybrid energy storage system (HESS), consisting of a battery and a supercapacitor, is integrated to the DC bus of the AC/DC converter via buck-boost DC/DC converters, and the DC bus voltage is stabilised by Lyapunov-based controllers, for providing stable and continuous power for DC payloads. Numerical results show that the performance of the W2W model with the proposed NMPC strategy is sensitive to sampling interval, prediction steps, current constraints and weight factors.

articleTitle: Coordinated control method for a photovoltaic-energy storage system using Kalman filtering
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Due to strong volatility, photovoltaic (PV) power generation is often paired with an energy storage system (ESS) to generate electricity. Although the ESS can smooth the fluctuation of PV, frequent charging and discharging operation can seriously affect its lifetime, especially when the output of PV is close to the load in an islanded microgrid. This paper proposes a coordinated control method for a PV-ESS using Kalman filtering. The output power reference of the PV system obtained by the original maximum power point tracking (MPPT) control is modified using Kalman filtering. Optimization in economics is adequately analyzed, considering both the loss caused by non-MPPT control and the benefit of reducing charging and discharging cycles. In addition, the DC-link capacitor is controlled to be charged and discharged to shorten non-MPPT control duration and smooth the fluctuation of the PV system further. To validate the performance of the proposed method, the simulations based on MATLAB are implemented under various scenarios, considering variable irradiance, loads, and capacity ratios of the PV and the ESS, both in grid-connected and islanded microgrids. The results show the proposed method can smooth the fluctuation of PV-ESS output power and significantly reduce the charging and discharging cycle.

articleTitle: Flexible optimal dispatching of distribution network considering the integration of intelligent soft switch
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The integration of high penetration renewable energy puts forward higher flexibility requirements for the power system. Based on the analysis of flexibility adjustment ability, considering node-type flexibility resources and network-type flexible resource intelligent soft switching (soft open point, SOP), and taking system economy as the optimization objective, a distribution network optimization scheduling model considering source-grid-load-storage flexibility resource coordination is proposed. Based on the power flow equation and constraint relaxation technology of distribution network, a second-order cone model for distribution network optimization is established. Considering the problem of low solving efficiency caused by the large set of scenery scenes affinity propagation (AP) clustering algorithm is used to reduce the scene, and the reduced scene is verified. The effects of the proposed model on improving the flexibility of the distribution network were analyzed from two flexibility quantification indexes, namely flexible supply and demand index and branch load margin index. Finally, the simulation results were carried out by using CPLEX solver through TPC 84 node example, and the results verified the effectiveness of the proposed optimization method in improving the economy and flexible regulation ability.

articleTitle: Day-ahead scheduling of park-level integrated energy system considering the decay characteristics of the battery
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low economic efficiency and poor thermal safety of battery energy storage in park-level integrated energy system (PIES), this paper proposes a low-carbon economic dispatching method for PIES considering the electrothermal oupling characteristics of batteries. Firstly, we construct a battery electro-thermal coupling model through COMSOL finite element simulation and develop the corresponding convexity method, then, we analyse the coupling characteristics of electric, gas, cold and heat energy flows and consider the temperature characteristics of battery energy storage to construct a PIES low carbon economic operation model, finally, we combine the battery energy storage operation model with carbon emission cost and construct a mixed integer planning model with the objective of minimizing the total operation cost. Finally, the PIES low-carbon economic dispatching strategy is formulated. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, a simulation model is constructed according to different operation scenarios, and the proposed method is compared with the traditional method. The comparison results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the thermal safety and service life of battery energy storage operation and reduce the PIES operation cost.

articleTitle: Dynamic carbon emission responsibility factor evaluation for demand response in parks
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The spare energy storage capacity of 5G base stations, electric vehicles, and controllable air conditioners offers potential terminal flexibility to tackle the issues of inadequate energy storage capacity and flexible power sources in new power system construction. This paper evaluates the dispatchable capacity of these flexible resources and proposes a methodology that utilizes dynamic carbon emission responsibility factor signals to mobilize them for reducing carbon emissions in the park. Firstly, a dynamic carbon emission responsibility factor calculation model for the park is established, considering the operational states of thermal power units and flexible resources. Then, the analytical formula of the available capacity and power of energy storage was derived based on the reserve requirements. An incentive strategy was designed to guide energy storage charge and discharge and adaptively adjust their power using the dynamic carbon emission responsibility factor signals. Furthermore, a day-ahead coordinated scheduling model for terminal flexible resources in the park is formulated by comprehensively taking into account the capacity and power constraints of flexible resources. Case studies show that the proposed methodology can effectively motivate terminal flexible resources for active carbon response and improve their utilization rate while reducing carbon emissions.

articleTitle: Impact analysis of distributed energy resources in maintaining unbalanced voltage degree and DLMP
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The three-phase distribution system is evolving towards a more unbalanced one in terms of load consumption, which is harmful to both the distribution grid and user equipment. In this study, we integrate the voltage imbalance constraints into the three-phase distribution level market. However, the three-phase distribution locational marginal price (DLMP) may inevitably be affected and exhibit differences between phases. The deployment of distributed energy sources (DERs) is driving the distribution system to be more flexible and could help alleviate the imbalances of three-phase voltage and DLMP. First, the coupling relationship between phases is modelled, and three-phase unbalanced voltage constraints are considered by limiting the magnitude difference between phases. Next, the three-phase nonlinear power losses are linearized via the Taylor expansion. Then, a three-phase distribution market model with multiple types of DERs is established. Finally, the proposed model is tested on the IEEE 33-bus system. The simulation results show that the integration of voltage imbalance constraints and DERs can make the voltage profile between phases more balanced and significantly impact the three-phase DLMP.

articleTitle: Lightning interference identification method for MMC-HVDC lines based on traveling wave waveform characteristics
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The fault current of the MMC-HVDC system increases rapidly, thus the fault develops fast and the influence range is wide. The line protection needs to complete the fault identification within 3 ms. Under the condition of the extremely short data window, lightning strike interference is likely to cause misoperation of transient signal based main protection. This paper analyzes the characteristics of fault traveling waves (TWs) of MMC-HVDC lines under different lightning conditions. Combining the opening size characteristic of the quadratic fitting function of the forward TW and the mean value of the backward TW, this paper proposes an ultra-high-speed lightning interference identification method for MMC-HVDC grids. The simulation results show that the proposed method can accurately identify different types of lightning interference with ultra-high-speed, and also has the advantages of high reliability and strong resistance to transition resistance.

articleTitle: Analysis of the non-minimum phase characteristics of the VSC system in a weak grid
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: This paper focuses on the non-minimum phase characteristics of the VSC systems under weak grid conditions, and analyses the stability mechanism of VSC systems. Firstly, a specific single input single output (SISO) openloop transfer function is determined through mathematical modelling. From the transfer function, it can be seen that the non-minimum phase characteristics are mainly related to the outer-loop control of the system, so this paper focuses on the stability study relatedto the outer-loop control.Then, theNyquist and Bode diagrams are used to analyse the non-minimum phase characteristics of the VSC system under outer-loop control withtheconstant active and constant AC voltage (PVac), and to analyse the factors affecting the stability of the VSC system in the outer-loop control. The results show that the non-minimum phase characteristics of the VSC system are caused by the interaction between the outer-loop and the PLL(Phase Locked Loop).

articleTitle: An evaluation method for primary frequency regulation performance of renewable energy stations based on field recording data
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The requirement that renewable energy units participate in the primary frequency regulation has been gradually introduced into the management rules of various localities. However, the current evaluation method of primary frequency regulation performance of renewable energy station focuses on the comprehensive evaluation of primary frequency regulation performance of the station and cannot accurately characterize its initial dynamic characteristics, so it is not suitable for field field recording data analysis. To this end, a segmental evaluation method for the performance of station primary frequency regulation is proposed in this study. Based on the description of the existing evaluation methods, their shortcomings are revealed. Then, according to the dynamic characteristics of primary frequency regulation, the field recording data are analysed and evaluated in segments to achieve the accurate characterization of the whole process of primary frequency regulation performance. The test results report that the proposed segmentation evaluation method can be effectively applied to the analysis on the field data of primary frequency regulation and accurately evaluate the primary frequency regulation performance of the station, which provides an alternative scheme for the real-time evaluation on the primary frequency regulation performance of the renewable energy station.

articleTitle: Optimization and application of reactive power control strategy of photovoltaic power station fault ride-through considering grid loss
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: When the power grid fails, the reactive power support capacity of the photovoltaic power station is an important indicator of the grid-connected performance of the photovoltaic power station. In order to solve the problem of insufficient reactive power support capacity during the fault ride-through of the current photovoltaic power station, this paper proposes a reactive power control strategy of photovoltaic power station fault ride-through considering the loss of the grid. Firstly, according to the internal grid structure of the photovoltaic power station, the whole station model is established, and the reactive current at the gridconnected point is taken as the control target, and the reactive power response current that the inverter should output under various faults is simulated and calculated. Then, taking the reactive power response current that the inverter should output as the goal, the inverter reactive power control strategy is optimized so that the reactive power output of the whole station meets the requirements of the power grid. Finally, the 30MW photovoltaic power station fault ride-though reactive power control strategy is optimized and verified, and the rationality and effectiveness of the reactive power control strategy are verified.

articleTitle: High-frequency fault voltage-based phase selector for photovoltaic power plant outgoing lines
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The fault characteristics of photovoltaic (PV) power plant are influenced by inverter control strategy, resulting in the malfunction of traditional power frequency phase selection method. Theoretical analysis indicates that inverters can be approximate to linear components in high-frequency superimposed network and its impedance tends to stabilize. On this basis, we analyse the characteristics of superimposed voltage in frequency domain. According to the amplitude relationship of high-frequency superimposed phase voltage during different types of faults, this study proposes a transient high-frequency fault voltage-based phase selector for photovoltaic power plant outgoing lines. This method can immune to weak feed systems. The results show that the method can accurately and fast identify the fault phases and fault type.

articleTitle: Research on the operating mechanism and harmonic transmission characteristics of hybrid cascaded DC topology
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The hybrid cascaded DC technology combines the technical advantages of line commutated converter(LCC) long-distance high-capacity transmission and voltage source converter(VSC) multi-drop power supply, flexible operation and strong system support capability, providing a transformative solution for the efficient utilization of large-scale clean energy and the construction of energy Internet. This paper firstly introduces the overview of the Baihetan project, then studies the steady-state and transient operation mechanism of the hybrid cascaded DC technology scheme, composes the operation mode of the hybrid cascaded DC scheme, proposes its basic control strategy, reveals the fault development process of DC line fault and AC system fault and proposes its fault ride-through strategy. Finally, the mechanism and impact analysis of DC-side harmonics on AC-side harmonics transmission are studied, and the small harmonic voltage characteristics caused by DC-side harmonic currents are explored, revealing the mechanism that the kth harmonic voltage on the valve side of the converter caused by DC-side kth harmonic currents will not be transmitted to the network side.

articleTitle: Few-shot ultra-short-term wind power forecasting based on the meta-learning framework
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Accurate wind power forecasting is really import to improve the coordinated operation ability between wind farms and power systems. However, it is difficult to establish high-precision forecasting models for new-built wind farms that lack sufficient historical data. To address the problem of poor forecasting accuracy of new-built wind farms due to limited samples, this paper proposes a few-shot ultra-short-term wind power forecasting method based on meta-learning.
