In the meta-training phase, the neural network is trained with sufficient sample data collected from the source wind farms to learn meta-knowledge that can be transferred, and limited sample data from the target wind farm is used in the meta-testing phase to fully learn the sample features and adaptively adjust the model parameters. In this paper, experiments were conducted using seven wind farm datasets from the same region of the world. The forecasting accuracy of the meta-learning method is improved over the baseline model at 5 and 10 days of training sample data, respectively. The meta-learning optimized Transformer model is highly adaptive and improves the forecasting accuracy to a certain extent compared to existing few-shot ultra-short-term wind power forecasting methods.

articleTitle: Research on the fault diagnose of power transformers based on the vibration and sound signal joint detection
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: When the power transformer runs for a long time, it may produce abnormal noise due to factors such as poor core quality, excessive inspirational current, winding deformation, or internal components loosening. In order to determine whether there are any faults in the running power transformer with large noise, as well as the fault type and location, it decided to take the live line detection on vibration and sound signals. For the fully display of the vibration of the transformer body, it selected by 16 points on the transformer as the measurement point of the vibration signal, and 4 points were selected at the four sides of the left, right, front and back of the transformer, and extracted the feature values of the vibration signal. At the same time, the overall running noise data of the transformer were collected. Then the article judges the fault that the transformer may exist based on the analysis of the distribution of the measuring point and the signal feature data. It believed that the loosening fault of the upper left side of one transformer existed. The research conclusions of this article can provide valuable references for relevant researchers and power equipment operation and maintenance personnel.

articleTitle: Enhancing renewable integration through optimized digital twin solutions with incremental discretization
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Digital Twin of renewable integration equipment refers to the concept of creating a digital representation of the equipment by collecting streaming data from sensors and other sources to develop a machine learning model. By training the model based on historical data, the model should be able to predict system behavior based on streaming data inputs. Most models are static, but the streaming data may be non-stationary in the case of relevant factors, and that discretization of numeric data streams is perceived as undesirable. We argue that it can be desirable for a discretization to evolve in synchronization with an evolving data stream. We investigate the discretization of various streaming data from the equipment and implement computationally efficient incremental discretization algorithms. We show that allowing a discretization to drift in synchronization with distribution drift can further identify anomalies, detect potential issues, and predict future behavior based on real-time data. The incorporation of incremental discretization into the model enables continuous updates, leading to a more accurate representation of the renewable integration equipment. This improved accuracy facilitates better decision-making and optimization of renewable integration performance.

articleTitle: Active power regulation control of grid-tied system for transient stability enhancement
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: With the high penetration of renewable energy sources, the grid stiffness goes weak. When the fault occurs, the system trends to be unstable in the weak grid. To enhance the transient stability of the system, it is vital to design the new control. Therefore, the paper builds the state-space model of the system with considering the DC voltage loop. The influence of the short-circuit ratio on the system is analysed. An active power regulation control is proposed to enhance the transient stability of the system. The control can regulate the active power with frequency feedback. The state-space model of the system with the proposed control is built. The impact of parameters on the system stability is analysed. The proposed control makes the system operate in the weaker grid and improve the transient stability of the system under fault. Finally, the simulation and experiment results validate the effectiveness of the proposed control.

articleTitle: Research on the technology of the simulation experimental platform system for the real operating environment of substation equipment
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: With the gradual deepening of the application of renewable energy in grid power generation, energy and power security, as an important component of China's national security, are increasingly prominent and important. Nowadays, the reliability requirements for power equipment are constantly increasing, and the existing detection and diagnosis technologies for power transformers are far from meeting the needs of preventing and warning major accidents. In order to solve the problem of existing transformer simulation not reflecting the actual operating status of equipment defects, this article mainly studies the construction plan of a substation fault degradation simulation platform. The method and system achieve a rated voltage and current composite circuit through the mutual load connection of two three-phase transformers, and achieve a real simulation of rated operating conditions through a step-up transformer to build a composite circuit of rated voltage and current, The operating conditions of the synthetic circuit are the same as the actual rated operating conditions of the transformer. In addition, this paper also gives a brief description of the requirements related to civil engineering and electromechanical design of Transformer Fault Simulation Platform, which can be used as a reference for those engaged in relevant test research and laboratory design.

articleTitle: Coordinated fault ride through parameter optimization of wind generators based on successive quadratic programming under multiple operation schemes
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: To enhance voltage stability, improve delivery ability of energy, especially in sending-end weak power system with largescale wind power integration, a systemic approach is proposed of wind generator over and under voltage ride though parameters optimization to cope with different contingencies and multiple operation schemes. Trajectory sensitivities of connection point voltage response with respect to the parameters of wind generators are first obtained through simulations. A quadratic programming is then established to meet the requirements of voltage response, under different contingencies and schemes. The voltages controlled linearly by the parameters through the trajectory sensitivities are as constraints, as well as standard required parameter range. Minimum parameter adjustment is as object. Successive quadratic programming is established to further adjust the parameters as long as electromechanical transient simulation suggest that the connection point voltage does not response as is required. The proposed approach has more robustness brought by quadratic programming, and advantage of lower controller design requirement brought by minimum parameter adjustment, especially suitable when voltage stability is sensitive to parameters and may be lost as parameters is largely adjusted. The proposed approach is validated by a real power system data with large-scale wind power integration and power export.

articleTitle: Influence of pressure gradient on the wake evolution of aligned wind turbines: A large-eddy simulation study
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Numerous wind farms have been built on complex terrain. Complex terrain will induce non-zero pressure gradients and thus affect the evolution of wind-turbine wakes. Previous studies mainly focused on the effect of pressure gradient on the wake evolution of a single wind turbine. However, it is not clear how the pressure gradient affects the wake evolution of a row of wind turbines. Therefore, we utilize large-eddy simulation coupled with wall-modelled immersed boundary method to simulate different pressure gradients and investigate their influence on the wake evolution of aligned wind turbines. Results show that the pressure gradient will significantly affect the velocity deficit, wake recovery rate, and wake width of the wake of aligned wind turbines. Compared with the zero-pressure gradient condition, the wake of aligned wind turbines has the smallest velocity deficit and the fastest recovery rate in the favorable pressure gradient (FPG) condition, while the velocity deficit is the largest and the recovery rate is the slowest in the adverse pressure gradient (APG) condition. At the same location downstream of aligned wind turbines, the wake width for the FPG condition is the smallest, and the wake width for the APG condition is the largest.

articleTitle: Torsional vibration control of wind turbine drive train based on Kalman filter
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Taking the drive train of the double-fed wind turbine as the research object, the dynamic model of the drive train of the wind turbine was established and the reason of the torsional vibration of the drive train was analysed. Based on the dynamic model, the torsional vibration controller of the drive train based on the Kalman filter was designed. By using the method of numerical simulation of a 2.0 MW offshore wind turbine bladed model, the damping effect of the band-pass filter controller and the Kalman filter controller is compared. The simulation results show that under the feedback control of generator speed, the amplitude of torsional angle fluctuation is reduced by about 50%, while the damping effect of Kalman filter feedback control is further strengthened, reducing by about 60%. Generator power fluctuations were small and average power was affected slightly, thus the energy yield was greatly reduced.

articleTitle: Research on optimization of control strategy for improving tap changers in UHV DC engineering
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: This article mainly focuses on the strategy research of reducing the action of tap changer in multiple converter accidents. Firstly, the working principle of the tap changer in high-voltage direct current transmission engineering is analyzed, and the principles of traditional tap changer control strategies are analyzed. Based on this, an improved tap changer control strategy principle is proposed, and various strategies are designed using Binjin DC as an example. The conclusion shows that this strategy can effectively reduce the number of tap changer actions.

articleTitle: PV integrated modular multilevel converter based battery energy storage system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The need for auxiliary services and the growing use of distributed generation with renewable energy sources drive the use of battery energy storage systems (BESS) in micro-grids and smart grids. This paper focuses on the mathematical model and power flow control of PV integrated modular multilevel converter (PV-MMC) with BESS. The study of PV integrated MMCBESS can be seen as a three-terminal network, DC bus connected PV array, AC side of the grid or load, and each sub-module access to battery storage. Moreover, through the AC and DC side current control, the free flow of three-terminal energy is attained. According to mathematical modeling and analysis, the control method of AC and PV-side is obtained, and discharging and charging control of batteries is realized by controlling the AC and PV-side power. Power control as the fundamental, the balancing control of BES is also studied in detail, phase-phase and intra-phase balance control strategies are tested in MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Optimal design of neural network structure for power system frequency security constraints
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Recently, frequency security is challenged by high uncertainty and low inertia in power system with high penetration of Renewable Energy Sources (RES). In the context of Unit Commitment (UC) problems, frequency security constraints represented by neural networks have been developed and embedded into the optimisation problem to represent complicated frequency dynamics. However, there are two major disadvantages related to this technique: the risk of overconfident prediction and poor computational efficiency. To handle these disadvantages, novel methodologies are proposed to optimally design the neural network structure, including the use of asymmetric loss function during the training stage and scientifically selecting neural network size and topology. The effectiveness of the proposed methodologies are validated by case study which reveals the improvement of conservativeness and mitigation of computation performance issues.

articleTitle: Empirical comparative study on outdoor power generation performance of BIPV modules based on multi-climate regions
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: In order to evaluating the power generation performance of BIPV modules with same type in different climatic environment regions, the evaluation methods and processes of the outdoor performance for BIPV modules are proposed. Based on the evaluation methods and processes, the outdoor operation performance monitoring platform of BIPV modules is developed for different climatic environments. Three different climatic regions, which namely cold-temperature grassland, warm-temperature mountain area and plateau cold-temperature area are chosen to carry out outdoor empirical monitoring for BIPV modules. Based on the analysis of BIPV module power generation data in different regions, combined with local meteorological resources, the reasons for the differences in BIPV module power generation performance in different regions are studied, and relevant suggestions are put forward for the application of BIPV modules.

articleTitle: An overview of hybrid control strategy presenting grid-following and grid-forming capabilities
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The increasing penetration of renewable energy sources has led to the widespread use of grid-following (GFL) and grid-forming (GFM) converters. However, both GFL and GFM converters may suffer from instability under certain grid conditions. In response to this challenge, several hybrid control strategies have been proposed to merge the advantages of both GFL and GFM control strategies. Firstly, this paper discusses the instability risks of GFL and GFM converters, highlighting the need for a hybrid control strategy. A comprehensive review of the existing hybrid control strategies is then provided, including dual-mode control strategy, hybrid synchronization control strategy, and parallel aggregation control strategy. The benefits and limitations of each control strategy are discussed. To address the limitations of the existing control strategies, we propose a novel adaptive hybrid control strategy which exhibits great stability under strong and weak grids. Simulation results are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Study on reactive power configuration scheme for converter stations with high proportion of new energy integration
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: In response to the frequent switching of circuit breakers and frequent action of tap changers in the AC filter group of Yinchuan East Converter Station, and considering the characteristics of the AC power grid with a high proportion of new energy connected to the transmission end, the reactive power configuration scheme of Yinchuan East Converter Station was studied and feasible solutions were proposed, providing reference for the subsequent construction, operation, and maintenance of Yinchuan East Converter Station.

articleTitle: SSR mitigation of series-compensated DFIG wind farms by a damping controller with lead-lag compensator
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Interaction between doubly fed induction generator (DFIG)-based wind farms and series-compensated networks can lead to sub-synchronous resonance (SSR). This paper develops a 21st-order state space model to analyze the SSR eigenvalue. Then, a damping controller with a lead-lag compensator is proposed to mitigate the oscillation based on the residue method and root locus diagram. At the same time, the selection of input control signals (ICS) and integration rules of the damping controller are discussed to improve the performance of the SSR mitigation. Time-domain digital simulation indicates that the damping loop integrated to the q-axis of RSC or the d-axis of GSC, with VC and PL as ICS is a more effective way for mitigating SSR.

articleTitle: Consensus-based hierarchical optimization scheduling method for large-scale reefer loads in ports
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The optimal scheduling of large-scale reefers in ports faces significant challenges in computational efficiency and solution accuracy. This paper proposes a hierarchical iterative scheduling architecture and the multi-agent refrigerating efficiency consensus optimization strategy to cope with such challenges. The reefer is modelled by analysing the thermodynamic process. Reefers are clustered according to power characteristics to reduce the control dimensions and the information interactions. The pre-scheduling model for the iterative optimization of dynamic price and reefer cluster consumption is established. A leader-follower refrigerating efficiency consensus algorithm for power dynamic allocation is proposed to ensure each reefer responds actively to the pre-scheduling strategy according to electricity price, temperature, and cooling limits. The proposed method enables self-optimizing operation of massive reefers and orderly load transfer. Finally, taking Rizhao Port as an example, the proposed method can reduce the electricity cost and meanwhile increase the computational efficiency. It provides a fast and accurate solution for optimal scheduling of large-scale reefer loads.

articleTitle: Comparison of peak short-circuit current between traditional and renewable energy sources
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The study of peak short-circuit current (PSCC) is significant for rating electrical equipment. This paper first analyses the fault characteristics of renewable energy sources (RESs), such as doubly-fed induction generators, permanent magnet synchronous generators and photovoltaic sources. And a PSCC calculation method of RESs is proposed, which does not rely heavily on parameters. Based on this, a comparative analysis of the PSCC between synchronous generators, asynchronous machines and RESs is carried out. Compared with synchronous generators and asynchronous motors, RESs' short-circuit current has other frequency components, and the time of the PSCC is no longer half a power cycle.

articleTitle: Small-signal stability analysis of inverter-interfaced renewable energy
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: With the integration of large-scale wind farms and photovoltaics, the conventional thermal power plants in the sending-side AC network of ultra-high voltage direct current (UHVDC) transmission system have been largely replaced. This leads to the decrease of the short-circuit ratio (SCR) of the sending-end AC system and weaken its stability. In this paper, the operation stability of the sending-end AC system, which is connected to voltage-source converter (VSC) and has high penetration of renewable energy, have been analysed by motion equation modelling. The key factors which influenced the dynamic interaction between wind turbines, the synchronous generator and VSC-HVDC have been illustrated. On the basis of clarifying the influence of the proportion of renewable energy output, the renewable energy units control parameters, the equivalent impedance of sending-end AC system and the AC filter of VSC, according the renewable energy output predicted result, a comprehensive strategy of control parameter tuning and AC filter choice has been proposed to ensure system transient stability. Finally, the simulation model constructed on PSCAD/EMTDC has verified the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: The research of the superconducting magnetic energy storage model based on the real time digital system
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Energy storage technologies play a key role in the renewable energy system, especially for the system stability, power quality, and reliability of supply. Various energy storage models have been established to support this research, such as the battery model in the Real Time Digital System (RTDS). However, the Superconducting Magnetic Energy Storage (SMES) model has not been built in RTDS. In this paper, the SMES model with fast response capability is developed with RSCAD/RTDS. The following aspects of the research have been carried out. Firstly, a SMES unit that stores energy in the magnetic field generated by the DC current flowing through a superconducting coil is established. Then, the voltage source converter (VSC) to interface with the ac system and a DC-DC chopper to charge/discharge the coil are developed. Thirdly the control strategies of the SMES considering load levelling, dynamic voltage support, and enhancing transient and dynamic stability are exploited. Finally, the SMES model is verified in RTDS.

articleTitle: Review of intelligent sensing technology research for power inspection robots
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: This paper presents an overview of the sensing technologies employed in power inspection robots. It explores three main perspectives. Firstly, it summarizes the sensing technologies utilized by power inspection robots for environmental detection, encompassing partial discharge, temperature, and gas detection. Secondly, it investigates the sensing technologies and their applications for environmental perception in power inspection robots, focusing on vision and touch sensing. Furthermore, the paper reviews the advancements in multi-sensor fusion technology and highlights key challenges and future research directions, particularly in enhancing fault tolerance and robustness. In conclusion, this paper offers valuable insights into the current state of sensing technology for power inspection robots while providing a meaningful outlook on future development in this field.

articleTitle: Research and application of main control system for 2MW direct-driven PMSG-based wind turbine
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: A main control system is proposed to achieve safe and stable operation for PMSG-based wind turbines, employing a consistent concept for overall top-level design and sub-module development. A parameter-hierarchical alarm method is presented based on state code. An automatic start-stop strategy is realized with the utilization of state machine. Event snapshots and fault recording using a sliding window are designed. The joint control procedure with the pitch system and converter is illustrated. Considering the nonlinear relationship between pneumatic torque and pitch angle, a pitch dual PI controller with variable gain and variable integration time constants is constructed, utilizing a tower damper, low pass filter, and notch filter. The 3D turbulent wind whose probability distribution conforms to the Weibull distribution is chosen for simulation. Based on Bladed software, a simulation model of the full turbine is established, and calculations of static characteristics, modal analysis, dynamic simulation, and load are done to validate the specified control strategy. The proposed control system is designed based on PLC and applied to a real 2MW wind turbine on a wind farm in Shandong Province. The proposed study is able to provide knowledge for further development and application of similar wind turbines.

articleTitle: Data-driven transmission line fault location with data-efficient transfer learning
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Transmission line fault location is one of the essential steps to ensure power supply reliability. Traditional model based methods and traveling wave based methods have limitations such as requirements of accurate line parameters or high sampling rates. Existing data-driven methods usually require large number of training data that are exactly consistent with the practical power system. However, the number of fault data in practical systems are usually quite limited, and there could be mismatch between the practical system and the simulation system, limiting the fault location accuracy. To this end, this paper proposes a transfer learning based data-driven fault location method for transmission lines. The method can efficiently utilize small dataset in practical power systems. First, a neural network is constructed and is pre-trained with extensive data generated by the simulation system A. Next, another very small dataset is generated by simulation system B to mimic the practical scenario, where the line parameters are different from simulation system A. The transfer learning efficiently utilizes the small dataset to update the neural network, with the steps of freeze-training and fine-tuning. Finally, the performances of data-driven methods with and without transfer learning are compared. The results clearly indicate the effectiveness and necessity of the proposed transfer learning based fault location method.

articleTitle: Review on application of magnetic current sensor in condition monitoring of power transmission and transformation equipment
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Magnetic sensor has many advantages, such as high sensitivity, small size, low power consumption, etc. It can be widely used in information technology, electronic power, energy industry, automotive electronics, industrial automation and other fields. The safe operation of power transmission and transformation equipment is of great significance to ensure the stability of the power grid and improve the power quality. At present, the status assessment of power transmission and transformation equipment has problems such as incomplete state perception, poor data transmission quality, and low accuracy of the assessment model. Based on the brief introduction of the principle of magnetic sensor, the application of magnetic sensor in the field of power transmission and transformation is introduced. The research of magnetoresistive current sensing device in transmission line and transformer condition monitoring is emphatically analyzed, and the development trend and application prospect of magnetoresistive current sensing device are summarized and prospected.

articleTitle: Ring busbar differential protection scheme based on inverse-time principle for closed-loop offshore-platforms power systems
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The closed-loop power system has the advantages of energy saving, emission reduction and improving efficiency of the entire offshore-platform. It has become the preferred alternative for dynamic positioning offshore-platform power systems which require high reliability in complex and harsh environment. However, due to the intercoupling between the distribution boards of the closed-loop power system, the fault will affect the adjacent segment which result in the challenges of diagnosing faulty distribution board. Regarding the difficulties in coordination between the upper and lower levels of protection, the concept of core layer and regional layer in the closed-loop offshore-platform power system is introduced. To prevent the blackout of whole offshore-platform, this paper proposes a ring busbar differential protection scheme that enables the adjacent distribution board to serve as the backup protection for the faulty distribution board. This busbar differential protection also introduces inverse-time principle which allows for adaptive adjustment of the operation time based on the severity of fault. The closed-loop offshore-platform power system is built in Matlab / Simulink and the results show that the protection scheme can quickly and accurately remove the faulty distribution board which can ensure the safety and reliability for the closed-loop power system of offshore-platforms.

articleTitle: Design of seismic test platform for electrical equipment with large-scale renewable energy generation
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: The research on ultra-high voltage AC/DC transmission systems with large-scale renewable energy generation (REG) has become a hot topic of widespread concern in the industry, the anti-seismic level of UHV AC/DC electrical equipment has always been concerned by users and anufacturers. Through seismic test of the equipment, the basic data such as the natural frequency, acceleration of key parts and strain response of the equipment can be obtained, which is of great significance to discover the potential defects of the equipment and improve its seismic level. This paper analyzes the characteristics of typical seismic structures of electrical equipment and requirements of relevant test standards. According to the parameters and structural system characteristics of seismic sensitive equipment, and considering the manufacturing capacity of seismic table and standard requirements, a UHV AC/DC dual array seismic test platform is designed. In addition, this paper also gives a brief description of the requirements related to civil engineering and electromechanical design of the seismic laboratory, which can be used as a reference for those engaged in relevant test research and laboratory design.

articleTitle: Generation expansion planning of power system considering the impact of natural disasters under low-carbon transition
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: Driven by the strategic goal of low-carbon energy, the proportion of renewable energy is gradually increasing, and the power structure of the future power system is bound to undergo a fundamental change. However, with the global climate change, increasingly frequent natural disasters have brought great challenges to the safe and reliable power supply and low-carbon transition of power systems. This paper first models the carbon emission trajectory during the planning period, and proposes an evaluation model for the impact of natural disasters on carbon emissions in power system. On this basis, a power generation expansion planning model considering low-carbon target constraints and the impact of natural disasters is established. In the model, the investment cost of various power generation technologies and energy storage, the quota cost of renewable energy and the lowest annual operating cost are comprehensively considered, and the policy constraints such as carbon emission reduction targets, renewable energy penetration rate and power supply reliability are introduced. Finally, the proposed model is applied to a disaster-prone province in China, and the proportion of power installation and generation and carbon emission trajectory under different planning objectives from 2020 to 2060 are analysed, which verifies the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: An improved time domain protection considering the effect of distributed capacitance for ground fault in renewable energy transmission line
publicationTitle: 12th International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2023)
abstract: After a fault occurs in the grid, the short-circuit current of renewable energy sources presents a weak feedthrough, and strongly controlled fault characteristic and also has a large number of interharmonics due to the influence of fault ride-through control strategies and inverter current limiting, which is different from the fault characteristics of traditional synchronous generators, resulting in the decline of the reliability of conventional frequency distance protection. Recently, time domain distance protection has received more attention because it is less affected by the fault characteristics of the renewable energy sources. However, when the transmission line connected to the renewable energy station is long, the influence of line distributed capacitance cannot be ignored, resulting in large deviations in fault distance calculation. To solve the above problem, this paper proposes an improved time domain distance protection scheme for a long-distance transmission line, taking into account the influence of line distributed capacitance. The solution is based on a π-type equivalence model of the line, which improves the accuracy of the fault distance solution and forms the protection criterion by modifying the fault circuit equations to take into account of the effect of distributed capacitance. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed time-domain distance protection scheme are verified by extensive simulations based on PSCAD/EMTDC.
